BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_BOOTSTRAP.de: Der Build konnte nicht vorbereitet werden.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_BOOTSTRAP.pt: Não foi possível preparar o build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_BOOTSTRAP.nl: De build kon niet worden voorbereid.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_BOOTSTRAP.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η προετοιμασία της κατασκευής.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_BOOTSTRAP.bg: Компилацията не можа да бъде подготвена.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.en: The build finished but its file couldn’t be saved.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.es: El build terminó, pero no se pudo guardar su archivo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.fr: Le build est terminé, mais son fichier n’a pas pu être enregistré.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.it: Il build è terminato, ma non è stato possibile salvarne il file.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.de: Der Build ist fertig, aber seine Datei konnte nicht gespeichert werden.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.pt: O build terminou, mas não foi possível salvar o arquivo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.da: Buildet blev færdigt, men filen kunne ikke gemmes.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.nl: De build is klaar, maar het bestand kon niet worden opgeslagen.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.ar: انتهى البناء لكن تعذّر حفظ ملفه.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.el: Η κατασκευή ολοκληρώθηκε, αλλά το αρχείο της δεν αποθηκεύτηκε.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_FINISH.bg: Компилацията приключи, но файлът ѝ не можа да бъде запазен.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.es: El build falló. Revisa los logs.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.fr: Le build a échoué. Consultez les logs.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.it: Il build non è riuscito. Controlla i log.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.de: Der Build ist fehlgeschlagen. Prüfe die Logs.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.pt: O build falhou. Verifique os logs.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.nl: De build is mislukt. Bekijk de logs.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.el: Η κατασκευή απέτυχε. Ελέγξτε τα αρχεία καταγραφής.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_GENERIC.tr: Derleme başarısız oldu. Günlükleri kontrol edin.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.en: Delete the distribution certificate in the Apple Developer portal and build again.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.es: Borra el certificado de distribución en el portal de Apple Developer y vuelve a hacer el build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.fr: Supprimez le certificat de distribution dans le portail Apple Developer et relancez le build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.it: Elimina il certificato di distribuzione nel portale Apple Developer e ripeti il build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.de: Lösche das Distributionszertifikat im Apple-Developer-Portal und starte den Build erneut.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.pt: Exclua o certificado de distribuição no portal Apple Developer e faça o build novamente.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.da: Slet distributionscertifikatet i Apple Developer-portalen, og byg igen.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.nl: Verwijder het distributiecertificaat in het Apple Developer-portaal en bouw opnieuw.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.ar: احذف شهادة التوزيع من بوابة Apple Developer ثم أعد البناء.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.el: Διαγράψτε το πιστοποιητικό διανομής στην πύλη Apple Developer και κάντε ξανά την κατασκευή.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.bg: Изтрийте сертификата за разпространение в портала Apple Developer и компилирайте отново.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_DISTRIBUTION.tr: Apple Developer portalında dağıtım sertifikasını silin ve yeniden derleyin.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.en: The iOS certificates saved for this app are no longer valid.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.es: Los certificados de iOS guardados para esta app ya no son válidos.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.fr: Les certificats iOS enregistrés pour cette app ne sont plus valides.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.it: I certificati iOS salvati per questa app non sono più validi.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.de: Die für diese App gespeicherten iOS-Zertifikate sind nicht mehr gültig.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.pt: Os certificados iOS salvos para este app não são mais válidos.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.da: De iOS-certifikater, der er gemt til denne app, er ikke længere gyldige.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.nl: De iOS-certificaten die voor deze app zijn opgeslagen, zijn niet meer geldig.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.ar: شهادات iOS المحفوظة لهذا التطبيق لم تعد صالحة.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.el: Τα πιστοποιητικά iOS που έχουν αποθηκευτεί για αυτή την εφαρμογή δεν είναι πλέον έγκυρα.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.bg: Запазените iOS сертификати за това приложение вече не са валидни.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_INVALID_LOCAL_CERTIF.tr: Bu uygulama için kaydedilen iOS sertifikaları artık geçerli değil.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.en: Apple won’t create another distribution certificate. Remove one in the Apple Developer portal.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.es: Apple no permite crear otro certificado de distribución. Borra uno en el portal de Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.fr: Apple ne permet pas de créer un autre certificat de distribution. Supprimez-en un dans le portail Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.it: Apple non consente di creare un altro certificato di distribuzione. Eliminane uno nel portale Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.de: Apple erstellt kein weiteres Distributionszertifikat. Lösche eines im Apple-Developer-Portal.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.pt: A Apple não permite criar outro certificado de distribuição. Exclua um no portal Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.da: Apple vil ikke oprette endnu et distributionscertifikat. Slet et i Apple Developer-portalen.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.nl: Apple maakt geen extra distributiecertificaat aan. Verwijder er een in het Apple Developer-portaal.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.ar: لن تُنشئ Apple شهادة توزيع أخرى. احذف واحدة من بوابة Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.el: Η Apple δεν επιτρέπει άλλο πιστοποιητικό διανομής. Διαγράψτε ένα στην πύλη Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.bg: Apple не позволява друг сертификат за разпространение. Изтрийте един в портала Apple Developer.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MAXIMUM_PORTAL_CERTI.tr: Apple başka bir dağıtım sertifikası oluşturmuyor. Apple Developer portalında bir tanesini silin.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.en: A credentials file is missing (the App Store Connect .p8 key, the .jks keystore or the Play Store JSON). Upload it again in Credentials and build again.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.es: Falta un archivo de credenciales (la llave .p8 de App Store Connect, el keystore .jks o el JSON de Play Store). Vuelve a subirlo en Credenciales y construye de nuevo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.fr: Un fichier d’identifiants est manquant (la clé .p8 d’App Store Connect, le keystore .jks ou le JSON du Play Store). Importez-le à nouveau dans Identifiants et relancez le build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.it: Manca un file delle credenziali (la chiave .p8 di App Store Connect, il keystore .jks o il JSON del Play Store). Caricalo di nuovo in Credenziali e rifai il build.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.de: Eine Zugangsdatei fehlt (der .p8-Schlüssel von App Store Connect, der .jks-Keystore oder das Play-Store-JSON). Lade sie unter Zugangsdaten erneut hoch und starte den Build neu.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.pt: Falta um arquivo de credenciais (a chave .p8 do App Store Connect, o keystore .jks ou o JSON da Play Store). Envie-o novamente em Credenciais e faça o build de novo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.da: En fil med loginoplysninger mangler (App Store Connect-nøglen .p8, keystoren .jks eller Play Store-JSON-filen). Upload den igen under Loginoplysninger, og byg igen.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.nl: Er ontbreekt een bestand met gegevens (de .p8-sleutel van App Store Connect, de .jks-keystore of de Play Store-JSON). Upload het opnieuw bij Gegevens en build opnieuw.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.ar: ملف بيانات اعتماد مفقود (مفتاح ‎.p8 لـ App Store Connect أو مخزن المفاتيح ‎.jks أو ملف JSON الخاص بـ Play Store). ارفعه مرة أخرى في بيانات الاعتماد ثم أعد البناء.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.el: Λείπει ένα αρχείο διαπιστευτηρίων (το κλειδί .p8 του App Store Connect, το keystore .jks ή το JSON του Play Store). Ανέβασέ το ξανά στα Διαπιστευτήρια και κάνε ξανά την κατασκευή.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.bg: Липсва файл с идентификационни данни (ключът .p8 за App Store Connect, keystore .jks или JSON файлът за Play Store). Качи го отново в „Идентификационни данни“ и компилирай отново.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_MISSING_CREDENTIALS.tr: Bir kimlik bilgisi dosyası eksik (App Store Connect .p8 anahtarı, .jks anahtar deposu veya Play Store JSON dosyası). Kimlik Bilgileri bölümünde yeniden yükle ve tekrar derle.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.en: The previous build is no longer available to retry.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.es: El build anterior ya no está disponible para reintentarlo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.fr: Le build précédent n’est plus disponible pour une nouvelle tentative.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.it: Il build precedente non è più disponibile per riprovare.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.de: Der vorherige Build steht für einen neuen Versuch nicht mehr zur Verfügung.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.pt: O build anterior não está mais disponível para nova tentativa.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.da: Det forrige build er ikke længere tilgængeligt til et nyt forsøg.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.nl: De vorige build is niet meer beschikbaar om opnieuw te proberen.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.ar: لم يعد البناء السابق متاحًا لإعادة المحاولة.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.el: Η προηγούμενη κατασκευή δεν είναι πλέον διαθέσιμη για επανάληψη.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.bg: Предишната компилация вече не е налична за повторен опит.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING.tr: Önceki derleme yeniden denemek için artık kullanılamıyor.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.en: The build service didn’t respond. Try again later.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.es: El servicio de builds no respondió. Inténtalo más tarde.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.fr: Le service de build n’a pas répondu. Réessayez plus tard.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.it: Il servizio di build non ha risposto. Riprova più tardi.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.de: Der Build-Dienst hat nicht geantwortet. Versuche es später erneut.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.pt: O serviço de build não respondeu. Tente novamente mais tarde.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.da: Build-tjenesten svarede ikke. Prøv igen senere.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.nl: De buildservice reageerde niet. Probeer het later opnieuw.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.ar: لم تستجب خدمة البناء. حاول مرة أخرى لاحقًا.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.el: Η υπηρεσία κατασκευής δεν απάντησε. Δοκιμάστε ξανά αργότερα.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.bg: Услугата за компилиране не отговори. Опитайте отново по-късно.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_SERVICE.tr: Derleme hizmeti yanıt vermedi. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_STUCK_PENDING.it: Il build non è mai partito.

BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.en: The build took too long and was stopped.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.es: El build tardó demasiado y se detuvo.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.fr: Le build a pris trop de temps et a été arrêté.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.it: Il build ha richiesto troppo tempo ed è stato interrotto.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.de: Der Build hat zu lange gedauert und wurde gestoppt.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.pt: O build demorou demais e foi interrompido.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.da: Buildet tog for lang tid og blev stoppet.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.nl: De build duurde te lang en is gestopt.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.ar: استغرق البناء وقتًا طويلًا وتم إيقافه.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.el: Η κατασκευή διήρκεσε πολύ και σταμάτησε.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.bg: Компилацията отне твърде дълго и беше спряна.
BUILDER_BUILD_ERROR_TIMED_OUT.tr: Derleme çok uzun sürdü ve durduruldu.

BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.en: Checking the file. It can’t be cancelled now.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.es: Revisando el archivo. Ya no se puede cancelar.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.fr: Vérification du fichier. Il ne peut plus être annulé.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.it: Controllo del file in corso. Non si può più annullare.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.de: Die Datei wird geprüft. Abbrechen ist jetzt nicht mehr möglich.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.pt: Verificando o arquivo. Não é mais possível cancelar.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.da: Filen kontrolleres. Den kan ikke annulleres nu.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.nl: Het bestand wordt gecontroleerd. Annuleren kan nu niet meer.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.ar: جارٍ التحقق من الملف. لا يمكن الإلغاء الآن.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.el: Γίνεται έλεγχος του αρχείου. Δεν μπορεί πλέον να ακυρωθεί.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.bg: Файлът се проверява. Вече не може да се отмени.
BUILDER_BUILD_FINISHING_HELP.tr: Dosya kontrol ediliyor. Artık iptal edilemez.

BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.en: You can leave this page. The build’s status updates here.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.es: Puedes salir de esta página. El estado de la compilación se actualiza aquí.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.fr: Vous pouvez quitter cette page. Le statut du build se met à jour ici.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.it: Puoi lasciare questa pagina. Lo stato della compilazione si aggiorna qui.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.de: Du kannst diese Seite verlassen. Der Build-Status wird hier aktualisiert.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.pt: Você pode sair desta página. O status da compilação é atualizado aqui.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.da: Du kan forlade denne side. Byggets status opdateres her.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.nl: Je kunt deze pagina verlaten. De status van de build wordt hier bijgewerkt.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.ar: يمكنك مغادرة هذه الصفحة. تُحدَّث حالة البناء هنا.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.el: Μπορείτε να φύγετε από αυτή τη σελίδα. Η κατάσταση του build ενημερώνεται εδώ.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.bg: Можете да напуснете тази страница. Статусът на компилацията се обновява тук.
BUILDER_BUILD_LEAVE_PAGE.tr: Bu sayfadan ayrılabilirsiniz. Derleme durumu burada güncellenir.

BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.en: For Google Play. Upload it in Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.es: Para Google Play. Súbelo en Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.fr: Pour Google Play. Importez-le dans la Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.it: Per Google Play. Caricalo in Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.de: Für Google Play. Lade es in der Play Console hoch.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.pt: Para o Google Play. Envie pelo Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.da: Til Google Play. Upload den i Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.nl: Voor Google Play. Upload hem in Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.ar: لمتجر Google Play. ارفعه في Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.el: Για το Google Play. Ανεβάστε το στο Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.bg: За Google Play. Качете го в Play Console.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AAB_HELP.tr: Google Play için. Play Console’a yükleyin.

BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.en: Install on registered iPhones, by link or MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.es: Instala en iPhones registrados, por enlace o MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.fr: Installez-la sur des iPhone enregistrés, par lien ou MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.it: Installa su iPhone registrati, tramite link o MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.de: Auf registrierten iPhones installieren, per Link oder MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.pt: Instale em iPhones registrados, por link ou MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.da: Installer på registrerede iPhones via link eller MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.nl: Installeer op geregistreerde iPhones, via een link of MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.ar: ثبّته على أجهزة iPhone المسجّلة عبر رابط أو MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.el: Εγκατάσταση σε καταχωρημένα iPhone, μέσω συνδέσμου ή MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.bg: Инсталирайте на регистрирани iPhone чрез линк или MDM.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_AD_HOC_HELP.tr: Kayıtlı iPhone’lara bağlantı veya MDM ile yükleyin.

BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APK_HELP.fr: Installez-la directement sur des appareils Android.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APK_HELP.bg: Инсталирайте директно на устройства с Android.

BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.en: Signed for App Store Connect. Upload it with Transporter or Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.es: Firmada para App Store Connect. Súbela con Transporter o Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.fr: Signée pour App Store Connect. Importez-la avec Transporter ou Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.it: Firmata per App Store Connect. Caricala con Transporter o Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.de: Für App Store Connect signiert. Lade sie mit Transporter oder Xcode hoch.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.pt: Assinado para o App Store Connect. Envie com o Transporter ou o Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.da: Signeret til App Store Connect. Upload den med Transporter eller Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.nl: Ondertekend voor App Store Connect. Upload hem met Transporter of Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.ar: موقّع لـ App Store Connect. ارفعه باستخدام Transporter أو Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.el: Υπογεγραμμένο για το App Store Connect. Ανεβάστε το με το Transporter ή το Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.bg: Подписано за App Store Connect. Качете го с Transporter или Xcode.
BUILDER_BUILD_MODE_APP_STORE_HELP.tr: App Store Connect için imzalandı. Transporter veya Xcode ile yükleyin.

BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.en: Next step: upload it in Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.es: Siguiente paso: súbelo en Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.fr: Étape suivante : l’importer dans la Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.it: Passo successivo: caricalo in Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.de: Nächster Schritt: in der Play Console hochladen

BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.nl: Volgende stap: upload hem in Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.ar: الخطوة التالية: ارفعه في Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.el: Επόμενο βήμα: ανεβάστε το στο Play Console
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_AAB.bg: Следваща стъпка: качете го в Play Console

BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.en: Next step: upload it to App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.es: Siguiente paso: súbela a App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.fr: Étape suivante : l’importer dans App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.it: Passo successivo: caricala su App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.de: Nächster Schritt: zu App Store Connect hochladen
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.pt: Próximo passo: envie para o App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.da: Næste trin: upload den til App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.nl: Volgende stap: upload hem naar App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.ar: الخطوة التالية: ارفعه إلى App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.el: Επόμενο βήμα: ανεβάστε το στο App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.bg: Следваща стъпка: качете го в App Store Connect
BUILDER_BUILD_NEXT_STEP_APP_STORE.tr: Sonraki adım: App Store Connect’e yükleyin

BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_HELP.en: Your website opens at this domain, with HTTPS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_HELP.es: Tu sitio web abre en este dominio, con HTTPS.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.en: Keep the CNAME record in your DNS. If you remove it, this domain stops working.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.es: Mantén el registro CNAME en tu DNS. Si lo quitas, este dominio deja de funcionar.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.fr: Conservez l’enregistrement CNAME dans votre DNS. Si vous le supprimez, ce domaine cesse de fonctionner.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.it: Mantieni il record CNAME nel tuo DNS. Se lo rimuovi, questo dominio smette di funzionare.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.de: Behalte den CNAME-Eintrag in deinem DNS. Wenn du ihn entfernst, funktioniert diese Domain nicht mehr.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.pt: Mantenha o registro CNAME no seu DNS. Se você removê-lo, este domínio deixa de funcionar.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.da: Behold CNAME-posten i din DNS. Hvis du fjerner den, holder dette domæne op med at virke.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.nl: Houd het CNAME-record in je DNS. Als je het verwijdert, werkt dit domein niet meer.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.ar: احتفظ بسجل CNAME في إعدادات DNS. إذا أزلته، يتوقف هذا النطاق عن العمل.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.el: Διατηρήστε την εγγραφή CNAME στο DNS σας. Αν την αφαιρέσετε, αυτός ο τομέας σταματά να λειτουργεί.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.bg: Запазете CNAME записа във вашия DNS. Ако го премахнете, този домейн спира да работи.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP.tr: CNAME kaydını DNS’inizde tutun. Kaldırırsanız bu alan adı çalışmayı durdurur.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.en: When you save, _domain_ stops opening your website. Create the CNAME record for the new domain first: we check it when you save.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.es: Al guardar, _domain_ deja de abrir tu sitio web. Crea primero el registro CNAME del dominio nuevo: lo verificamos al guardar.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.fr: À l’enregistrement, _domain_ n’ouvre plus votre site web. Créez d’abord l’enregistrement CNAME du nouveau domaine : nous le vérifions à l’enregistrement.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.it: Quando salvi, _domain_ non apre più il tuo sito web. Crea prima il record CNAME del nuovo dominio: lo verifichiamo al salvataggio.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.de: Beim Speichern öffnet _domain_ deine Website nicht mehr. Lege zuerst den CNAME-Eintrag der neuen Domain an: Wir prüfen ihn beim Speichern.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.pt: Ao salvar, _domain_ deixa de abrir seu site. Crie primeiro o registro CNAME do novo domínio: nós o verificamos ao salvar.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.da: Når du gemmer, holder _domain_ op med at åbne dit website. Opret først CNAME-posten for det nye domæne: vi tjekker den, når du gemmer.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.nl: Na het opslaan opent _domain_ je website niet meer. Maak eerst het CNAME-record voor het nieuwe domein aan: we controleren het bij het opslaan.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.ar: عند الحفظ، يتوقف _domain_ عن فتح موقعك. أنشئ أولاً سجل CNAME للنطاق الجديد: نتحقق منه عند الحفظ.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.el: Μόλις αποθηκεύσετε, το _domain_ σταματά να ανοίγει τον ιστότοπό σας. Δημιουργήστε πρώτα την εγγραφή CNAME για τον νέο τομέα: την ελέγχουμε κατά την αποθήκευση.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.bg: При запазване _domain_ спира да отваря уебсайта ви. Първо създайте CNAME записа за новия домейн: проверяваме го при запазване.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING.tr: Kaydettiğinizde _domain_ web sitenizi açmayı bırakır. Önce yeni alan adı için CNAME kaydını oluşturun: kaydederken kontrol ederiz.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.en: Check that the domain is spelled right and that its CNAME record points to _target_, then verify again. If it keeps failing, contact support.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.es: Revisa que el dominio esté bien escrito y que su registro CNAME apunte a _target_, y verifica de nuevo. Si sigue fallando, contacta a soporte.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.fr: Vérifiez que le domaine est bien orthographié et que son enregistrement CNAME pointe vers _target_, puis vérifiez à nouveau. Si l’échec persiste, contactez le support.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.it: Controlla che il dominio sia scritto correttamente e che il suo record CNAME punti a _target_, poi verifica di nuovo. Se continua a non funzionare, contatta l’assistenza.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.de: Prüfe, ob die Domain richtig geschrieben ist und ihr CNAME-Eintrag auf _target_ zeigt, und prüfe dann erneut. Wenn es weiter fehlschlägt, wende dich an den Support.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.pt: Confira se o domínio está escrito corretamente e se o registro CNAME aponta para _target_, depois verifique de novo. Se continuar falhando, fale com o suporte.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.da: Tjek, at domænet er stavet rigtigt, og at dets CNAME-post peger på _target_, og bekræft igen. Hvis det bliver ved med at fejle, så kontakt support.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.nl: Controleer of het domein goed is gespeld en of het CNAME-record naar _target_ wijst, en verifieer opnieuw. Blijft het mislukken, neem dan contact op met support.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.ar: تأكد من كتابة النطاق بشكل صحيح ومن أن سجل CNAME الخاص به يشير إلى _target_، ثم تحقق مرة أخرى. إذا استمر الفشل، تواصل مع الدعم.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.el: Ελέγξτε ότι ο τομέας είναι γραμμένος σωστά και ότι η εγγραφή CNAME δείχνει στο _target_ και επαληθεύστε ξανά. Αν συνεχίσει να αποτυγχάνει, επικοινωνήστε με την υποστήριξη.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.bg: Проверете дали домейнът е изписан правилно и дали CNAME записът му сочи към _target_, след което проверете отново. Ако продължава да не успява, свържете се с поддръжката.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP.tr: Alan adının doğru yazıldığını ve CNAME kaydının _target_ adresine yönlendiğini kontrol edip yeniden doğrulayın. Hata sürerse destekle iletişime geçin.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.en: Create this record in your domain’s DNS, then save again
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.es: Crea este registro en el DNS de tu dominio y guarda de nuevo
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.fr: Créez cet enregistrement dans le DNS de votre domaine, puis enregistrez à nouveau
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.it: Crea questo record nel DNS del tuo dominio, poi salva di nuovo
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.de: Lege diesen Eintrag im DNS deiner Domain an und speichere erneut
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.pt: Crie este registro no DNS do seu domínio e salve de novo
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.da: Opret denne post i dit domænes DNS, og gem igen
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.nl: Maak dit record aan in de DNS van je domein en sla opnieuw op
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.ar: أنشئ هذا السجل في إعدادات DNS لنطاقك، ثم احفظ مرة أخرى
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.el: Δημιουργήστε αυτή την εγγραφή στο DNS του τομέα σας και αποθηκεύστε ξανά
BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD.bg: Създайте този запис в DNS на домейна си и запазете отново

BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.en: This domain is already used by another website.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.nl: Dit domein wordt al door een andere website gebruikt.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.ar: هذا النطاق مستخدم بالفعل من قبل موقع آخر.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.el: Αυτός ο τομέας χρησιμοποιείται ήδη από άλλον ιστότοπο.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.bg: Този домейн вече се използва от друг уебсайт.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN.tr: Bu alan adı zaten başka bir web sitesi tarafından kullanılıyor.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.en: This website’s domain is managed by support. Contact support to change it.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.es: El dominio de este sitio web lo gestiona soporte. Contacta a soporte para cambiarlo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.fr: Le domaine de ce site web est géré par le support. Contactez le support pour le modifier.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.it: Il dominio di questo sito web è gestito dall’assistenza. Contatta l’assistenza per cambiarlo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.de: Die Domain dieser Website wird vom Support verwaltet. Wende dich an den Support, um sie zu ändern.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.pt: O domínio deste site é gerenciado pelo suporte. Fale com o suporte para alterá-lo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.da: Dette websites domæne administreres af support. Kontakt support for at ændre det.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED.nl: Het domein van deze website wordt beheerd door support. Neem contact op met support om het te wijzigen.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_FIELD_HELP.it: Il sottodominio completo, come shop.tuomarchio.com. Puoi incollare l’indirizzo intero.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FIELD_HELP.de: Die vollständige Subdomain, z. B. shop.deinemarke.com. Du kannst die ganze Adresse einfügen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FIELD_HELP.pt: O subdomínio completo, como shop.suamarca.com. Você pode colar o endereço inteiro.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.it: Alcuni provider chiedono il nome completo, _domain_. Se l’hai appena creato, attendi qualche minuto e salva di nuovo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.de: Manche Anbieter verlangen den vollständigen Namen, _domain_. Wenn du ihn gerade angelegt hast, warte ein paar Minuten und speichere erneut.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.pt: Alguns provedores pedem o nome completo, _domain_. Se você acabou de criá-lo, espere alguns minutos e salve de novo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.da: Nogle udbydere beder om det fulde navn, _domain_. Hvis du lige har oprettet den, så vent et par minutter og gem igen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.nl: Sommige providers vragen de volledige naam, _domain_. Heb je het net aangemaakt, wacht dan een paar minuten en sla opnieuw op.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.ar: يطلب بعض المزودين الاسم الكامل، _domain_. إذا أنشأته للتو، فانتظر بضع دقائق ثم احفظ مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.el: Ορισμένοι πάροχοι ζητούν το πλήρες όνομα, _domain_. Αν μόλις τη δημιουργήσατε, περιμένετε λίγα λεπτά και αποθηκεύστε ξανά.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.bg: Някои доставчици изискват пълното име, _domain_. Ако току-що сте го създали, изчакайте няколко минути и запазете отново.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME.tr: Bazı sağlayıcılar tam adı ister: _domain_. Yeni oluşturduysanız birkaç dakika bekleyip yeniden kaydedin.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.en: Meanwhile your website keeps opening at its temporary address. Keep the CNAME record _name_ → _target_ in your DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.es: Mientras tanto tu sitio web sigue abriendo en su dirección temporal. Mantén el registro CNAME _name_ → _target_ en tu DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.fr: En attendant, votre site web reste ouvert à son adresse temporaire. Conservez l’enregistrement CNAME _name_ → _target_ dans votre DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.it: Nel frattempo il tuo sito web continua ad aprirsi al suo indirizzo temporaneo. Mantieni il record CNAME _name_ → _target_ nel tuo DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.de: Bis dahin öffnet sich deine Website weiter unter ihrer temporären Adresse. Behalte den CNAME-Eintrag _name_ → _target_ in deinem DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.pt: Enquanto isso, seu site continua abrindo no endereço temporário. Mantenha o registro CNAME _name_ → _target_ no seu DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.da: Imens åbner dit website stadig på sin midlertidige adresse. Behold CNAME-posten _name_ → _target_ i din DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.nl: Intussen opent je website nog steeds op het tijdelijke adres. Houd het CNAME-record _name_ → _target_ in je DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.ar: في هذه الأثناء يواصل موقعك الفتح على عنوانه المؤقت. احتفظ بسجل CNAME ‏_name_ → _target_ في إعدادات DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.el: Στο μεταξύ ο ιστότοπός σας συνεχίζει να ανοίγει στην προσωρινή του διεύθυνση. Διατηρήστε την εγγραφή CNAME _name_ → _target_ στο DNS σας.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.bg: Междувременно уебсайтът ви продължава да се отваря на временния си адрес. Запазете CNAME записа _name_ → _target_ във вашия DNS.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD.tr: Bu sırada web siteniz geçici adresinde açılmaya devam eder. _name_ → _target_ CNAME kaydını DNS’inizde tutun.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.it: Verifica di nuovo per configurarlo un’altra volta. Controlla prima che il suo record CNAME punti ancora a _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.de: Prüfe erneut, um sie neu einzurichten. Stelle vorher sicher, dass ihr CNAME-Eintrag noch auf _target_ zeigt.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.pt: Verifique de novo para configurá-lo outra vez. Antes, confira se o registro CNAME ainda aponta para _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.da: Bekræft igen for at sætte det op igen. Tjek først, at dets CNAME-post stadig peger på _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.nl: Verifieer opnieuw om het opnieuw in te stellen. Controleer eerst of het CNAME-record nog naar _target_ wijst.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.ar: تحقق مرة أخرى لإعداده من جديد. تأكد أولاً من أن سجل CNAME الخاص به لا يزال يشير إلى _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.el: Επαληθεύστε ξανά για να ρυθμιστεί από την αρχή. Ελέγξτε πρώτα ότι η εγγραφή CNAME δείχνει ακόμη στο _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.bg: Проверете отново, за да се настрои пак. Първо проверете дали CNAME записът му още сочи към _target_.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP.tr: Yeniden kurmak için tekrar doğrulayın. Önce CNAME kaydının hâlâ _target_ adresine yönlendiğini kontrol edin.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.en: We’re checking the CNAME record and getting the security certificate (HTTPS). This takes a few minutes, up to about 20. This page updates by itself, so you can leave it and come back.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.es: Estamos revisando el registro CNAME y obteniendo el certificado de seguridad (HTTPS). Esto toma unos minutos, hasta unos 20. Esta página se actualiza sola, así que puedes salir y volver.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.fr: Nous vérifions l’enregistrement CNAME et obtenons le certificat de sécurité (HTTPS). Cela prend quelques minutes, jusqu’à 20 environ. Cette page se met à jour toute seule : vous pouvez la quitter et revenir.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.it: Stiamo controllando il record CNAME e ottenendo il certificato di sicurezza (HTTPS). Ci vogliono alcuni minuti, fino a circa 20. Questa pagina si aggiorna da sola, quindi puoi uscire e tornare.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.de: Wir prüfen den CNAME-Eintrag und holen das Sicherheitszertifikat (HTTPS). Das dauert ein paar Minuten, bis zu etwa 20. Diese Seite aktualisiert sich selbst, du kannst sie also verlassen und später zurückkommen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.pt: Estamos verificando o registro CNAME e obtendo o certificado de segurança (HTTPS). Isso leva alguns minutos, até cerca de 20. Esta página se atualiza sozinha, então você pode sair e voltar.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.da: Vi tjekker CNAME-posten og henter sikkerhedscertifikatet (HTTPS). Det tager et par minutter, op til omkring 20. Siden opdaterer sig selv, så du kan gå og komme tilbage.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.nl: We controleren het CNAME-record en halen het beveiligingscertificaat (HTTPS) op. Dit duurt een paar minuten, tot ongeveer 20. Deze pagina werkt zichzelf bij, dus je kunt weggaan en terugkomen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.ar: نتحقق من سجل CNAME ونحصل على شهادة الأمان (HTTPS). يستغرق ذلك بضع دقائق، حتى 20 دقيقة تقريبًا. تتحدث هذه الصفحة تلقائيًا، لذا يمكنك مغادرتها والعودة لاحقًا.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.el: Ελέγχουμε την εγγραφή CNAME και λαμβάνουμε το πιστοποιητικό ασφαλείας (HTTPS). Αυτό διαρκεί λίγα λεπτά, έως περίπου 20. Η σελίδα ενημερώνεται μόνη της, οπότε μπορείτε να φύγετε και να επιστρέψετε.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.bg: Проверяваме CNAME записа и получаваме сертификата за сигурност (HTTPS). Това отнема няколко минути, до около 20. Страницата се обновява сама, така че можете да излезете и да се върнете.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP.tr: CNAME kaydını kontrol ediyor ve güvenlik sertifikasını (HTTPS) alıyoruz. Bu birkaç dakika, en fazla yaklaşık 20 dakika sürer. Bu sayfa kendi kendine güncellenir; çıkıp geri dönebilirsiniz.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT_HELP.it: Di solito ci vogliono alcuni minuti.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT_HELP.de: Das dauert meist ein paar Minuten.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT_HELP.da: Det tager som regel et par minutter.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT_HELP.nl: Dit duurt meestal een paar minuten.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.en: The CNAME record for _domain_ still isn’t there. Check it in your provider and try again in a few minutes.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.es: El registro CNAME de _domain_ todavía no está. Revísalo en tu proveedor e inténtalo de nuevo en unos minutos.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.fr: L’enregistrement CNAME de _domain_ n’est toujours pas là. Vérifiez-le chez votre fournisseur et réessayez dans quelques minutes.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.it: Il record CNAME di _domain_ non c’è ancora. Controllalo nel tuo provider e riprova tra qualche minuto.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.de: Der CNAME-Eintrag für _domain_ ist noch nicht da. Prüfe ihn bei deinem Anbieter und versuche es in ein paar Minuten erneut.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.pt: O registro CNAME de _domain_ ainda não está lá. Confira no seu provedor e tente de novo em alguns minutos.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.da: CNAME-posten for _domain_ er der stadig ikke. Tjek den hos din udbyder, og prøv igen om et par minutter.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.nl: Het CNAME-record voor _domain_ is er nog steeds niet. Controleer het bij je provider en probeer het over een paar minuten opnieuw.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.ar: سجل CNAME للنطاق _domain_ غير موجود بعد. تحقق منه لدى مزودك وحاول مرة أخرى بعد بضع دقائق.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.el: Η εγγραφή CNAME για το _domain_ δεν υπάρχει ακόμη. Ελέγξτε τη στον πάροχό σας και δοκιμάστε ξανά σε λίγα λεπτά.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.bg: CNAME записът за _domain_ все още липсва. Проверете го при доставчика си и опитайте отново след няколко минути.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING.tr: _domain_ için CNAME kaydı hâlâ yok. Sağlayıcınızda kontrol edin ve birkaç dakika sonra tekrar deneyin.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.en: Your website keeps opening at its temporary address.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.es: Tu sitio web sigue abriendo en su dirección temporal.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.fr: Votre site web reste ouvert à son adresse temporaire.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.it: Il tuo sito web continua ad aprirsi al suo indirizzo temporaneo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.de: Deine Website öffnet sich weiterhin unter ihrer temporären Adresse.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.pt: Seu site continua abrindo no endereço temporário.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.da: Dit website åbner stadig på sin midlertidige adresse.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.nl: Je website opent nog steeds op het tijdelijke adres.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.ar: يواصل موقعك الفتح على عنوانه المؤقت.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.el: Ο ιστότοπός σας συνεχίζει να ανοίγει στην προσωρινή του διεύθυνση.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.bg: Уебсайтът ви продължава да се отваря на временния си адрес.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY.tr: Web siteniz geçici adresinde açılmaya devam ediyor.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.en: Always works, also after you add your own domain.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.es: Siempre funciona, también después de agregar tu propio dominio.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.fr: Fonctionne toujours, même après l’ajout de votre propre domaine.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.it: Funziona sempre, anche dopo aver aggiunto il tuo dominio.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.de: Funktioniert immer, auch nachdem du deine eigene Domain hinzugefügt hast.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.pt: Sempre funciona, também depois de adicionar seu próprio domínio.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.da: Virker altid, også når du har tilføjet dit eget domæne.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.nl: Werkt altijd, ook nadat je je eigen domein hebt toegevoegd.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.ar: يعمل دائمًا، حتى بعد إضافة نطاقك الخاص.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.el: Λειτουργεί πάντα, και αφού προσθέσετε δικό σας τομέα.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.bg: Работи винаги, и след като добавите собствен домейн.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP.tr: Kendi alan adınızı ekledikten sonra da her zaman çalışır.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT.fr: Nous n’avons pas pu vérifier _domain_ à temps
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT.it: Non siamo riusciti a verificare _domain_ in tempo
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT.da: Vi kunne ikke bekræfte _domain_ i tide

BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT.ar: تعذر التحقق من _domain_ في الوقت المحدد
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η επαλήθευση του _domain_ εγκαίρως

BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.en: The CNAME record wasn’t found, or it was removed. Check that it points to _target_, then verify again.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.es: No se encontró el registro CNAME, o se quitó. Revisa que apunte a _target_ y verifica de nuevo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.fr: L’enregistrement CNAME est introuvable, ou il a été supprimé. Vérifiez qu’il pointe vers _target_, puis vérifiez à nouveau.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.it: Il record CNAME non è stato trovato, oppure è stato rimosso. Controlla che punti a _target_, poi verifica di nuovo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.de: Der CNAME-Eintrag wurde nicht gefunden oder entfernt. Prüfe, ob er auf _target_ zeigt, und prüfe dann erneut.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.pt: O registro CNAME não foi encontrado, ou foi removido. Confira se ele aponta para _target_ e verifique de novo.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.da: CNAME-posten blev ikke fundet, eller den er fjernet. Tjek, at den peger på _target_, og bekræft igen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.nl: Het CNAME-record is niet gevonden of is verwijderd. Controleer of het naar _target_ wijst en verifieer opnieuw.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.ar: لم يتم العثور على سجل CNAME أو تمت إزالته. تأكد من أنه يشير إلى _target_، ثم تحقق مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.el: Η εγγραφή CNAME δεν βρέθηκε ή αφαιρέθηκε. Ελέγξτε ότι δείχνει στο _target_ και επαληθεύστε ξανά.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.bg: CNAME записът не беше открит или е премахнат. Проверете дали сочи към _target_ и проверете отново.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP.tr: CNAME kaydı bulunamadı veya kaldırıldı. _target_ adresine yönlendiğini kontrol edip yeniden doğrulayın.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.en: Show your website at an address like www.yourbrand.com. It has to be a subdomain (www., shop., order.…): a root domain like yourbrand.com can’t be used.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.es: Muestra tu sitio web en una dirección como www.tumarca.com. Tiene que ser un subdominio (www., shop., order.…): no se puede usar un dominio raíz como tumarca.com.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.fr: Affichez votre site web à une adresse comme www.votremarque.com. Il doit s’agir d’un sous-domaine (www., shop., order.…) : un domaine racine comme votremarque.com ne peut pas être utilisé.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.it: Mostra il tuo sito web a un indirizzo come www.tuomarchio.com. Deve essere un sottodominio (www., shop., order.…): un dominio principale come tuomarchio.com non si può usare.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.de: Zeige deine Website unter einer Adresse wie www.deinemarke.com. Es muss eine Subdomain sein (www., shop., order.…): Eine Root-Domain wie deinemarke.com kann nicht verwendet werden.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.pt: Mostre seu site em um endereço como www.suamarca.com. Precisa ser um subdomínio (www., shop., order.…): um domínio raiz como suamarca.com não pode ser usado.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.da: Vis dit website på en adresse som www.ditbrand.com. Det skal være et underdomæne (www., shop., order.…): et roddomæne som ditbrand.com kan ikke bruges.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.nl: Toon je website op een adres als www.jouwmerk.com. Het moet een subdomein zijn (www., shop., order.…): een hoofddomein als jouwmerk.com kan niet worden gebruikt.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.ar: اعرض موقعك على عنوان مثل www.yourbrand.com. يجب أن يكون نطاقًا فرعيًا (www.‏، shop.‏، order.‏…): لا يمكن استخدام نطاق جذري مثل yourbrand.com.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.el: Εμφανίστε τον ιστότοπό σας σε μια διεύθυνση όπως www.yourbrand.com. Πρέπει να είναι υποτομέας (www., shop., order.…): ένας κύριος τομέας όπως yourbrand.com δεν μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.bg: Покажете уебсайта си на адрес като www.yourbrand.com. Трябва да е поддомейн (www., shop., order.…): основен домейн като yourbrand.com не може да се използва.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP.tr: Web sitenizi www.markaniz.com gibi bir adreste gösterin. Bir alt alan adı olmalıdır (www., shop., order.…): markaniz.com gibi bir kök alan adı kullanılamaz.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.en: Use a subdomain, like _domain_, and create its record
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.es: Usa un subdominio, como _domain_, y crea su registro
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.fr: Utilisez un sous-domaine, comme _domain_, et créez son enregistrement
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.it: Usa un sottodominio, come _domain_, e crea il suo record
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.de: Verwende eine Subdomain wie _domain_ und lege ihren Eintrag an
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.pt: Use um subdomínio, como _domain_, e crie o registro dele
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.da: Brug et underdomæne, f.eks. _domain_, og opret dets post
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.nl: Gebruik een subdomein, zoals _domain_, en maak het record ervan aan
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.ar: استخدم نطاقًا فرعيًا، مثل _domain_، وأنشئ سجله
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.el: Χρησιμοποιήστε έναν υποτομέα, όπως _domain_, και δημιουργήστε την εγγραφή του
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.bg: Използвайте поддомейн, например _domain_, и създайте записа му
BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN.tr: _domain_ gibi bir alt alan adı kullanın ve kaydını oluşturun

BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.en: We couldn’t verify the domain. Try again.

BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.it: Non siamo riusciti a verificare il dominio. Riprova.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.de: Wir konnten die Domain nicht prüfen. Versuche es erneut.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.pt: Não conseguimos verificar o domínio. Tente novamente.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.da: Vi kunne ikke bekræfte domænet. Prøv igen.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.nl: We konden het domein niet verifiëren. Probeer het opnieuw.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.ar: تعذر التحقق من النطاق. حاول مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η επαλήθευση του τομέα. Δοκιμάστε ξανά.
BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR.bg: Не успяхме да проверим домейна. Опитайте отново.

BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.en: The addresses where people open your website.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.es: Las direcciones donde la gente abre tu sitio web.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.fr: Les adresses où l’on ouvre votre site web.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.it: Gli indirizzi dove le persone aprono il tuo sito web.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.de: Die Adressen, unter denen Leute deine Website öffnen.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.pt: Os endereços onde as pessoas abrem seu site.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.da: De adresser, hvor folk åbner dit website.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.nl: De adressen waarop mensen je website openen.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.ar: العناوين التي يفتح الناس موقعك عليها.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.el: Οι διευθύνσεις όπου ανοίγουν οι χρήστες τον ιστότοπό σας.
BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP.bg: Адресите, на които хората отварят уебсайта ви.

BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_ERROR.en: We couldn’t download the file. Try again.

BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_MISSING.da: Filen fra dette build er ikke længere tilgængelig. Byg igen for at få en ny.

BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_NOT_SUCCESSFUL.en: Only successful builds can be downloaded.

BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_REPLACED.en: A newer _mode_ build replaced this file. Download that one instead.
BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_REPLACED.es: Una compilación _mode_ más reciente reemplazó este archivo. Descarga esa.

BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_REPLACED.tr: Daha yeni bir _mode_ derlemesi bu dosyanın yerini aldı. Onun yerine onu indirin.

BUILDER_ERROR_PACKAGE.en: Use a reverse domain like com.brand.app.

BUILDER_FILE_ERROR.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αποθήκευση του αρχείου. Δοκίμασε ξανά.

BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_SIZE.el: Το αρχείο πρέπει να είναι έως _size_.

BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.en: This type of file isn’t accepted.

BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.fr: Ce type de fichier n’est pas accepté.
BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.it: Questo tipo di file non è accettato.
BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.pt: Este tipo de arquivo não é aceito.
BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.ar: هذا النوع من الملفات غير مقبول.
BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.el: Αυτός ο τύπος αρχείου δεν γίνεται δεκτός.
BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC.bg: Този тип файл не се приема.

BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.en: Colors apply on the next build.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.es: Los colores se aplican en la próxima compilación.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.fr: Les couleurs s’appliquent lors de la prochaine compilation.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.it: I colori si applicano alla prossima build.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.de: Farben werden beim nächsten Build übernommen.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.pt: As cores são aplicadas na próxima compilação.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.nl: Kleuren worden toegepast bij de volgende build.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.el: Τα χρώματα εφαρμόζονται στο επόμενο build.
BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE.bg: Цветовете се прилагат при следващия билд.

BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.en: Retrying uses the settings of that attempt. To include newer changes, start a new build.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.es: Al reintentar se usa la configuración de ese intento. Para incluir cambios más nuevos, inicia una compilación nueva.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.fr: Une nouvelle tentative utilise les réglages de cette tentative. Pour inclure des modifications plus récentes, lancez un nouveau build.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.it: Il nuovo tentativo usa le impostazioni di quel tentativo. Per includere modifiche più recenti, avvia una nuova compilazione.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.de: Ein erneuter Versuch nutzt die Einstellungen dieses Versuchs. Für neuere Änderungen starte einen neuen Build.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.pt: Tentar novamente usa as configurações daquela tentativa. Para incluir mudanças mais recentes, inicie uma nova compilação.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.da: Et nyt forsøg bruger indstillingerne fra det forsøg. Start et nyt build for at få nyere ændringer med.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.nl: Opnieuw proberen gebruikt de instellingen van die poging. Start een nieuwe build om recentere wijzigingen mee te nemen.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.ar: تستخدم إعادة المحاولة إعدادات تلك المحاولة. لتضمين التغييرات الأحدث، ابدأ بناءً جديدًا.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.el: Η νέα προσπάθεια χρησιμοποιεί τις ρυθμίσεις εκείνης της προσπάθειας. Για να συμπεριλάβετε νεότερες αλλαγές, ξεκινήστε νέο build.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.bg: Повторният опит използва настройките на онзи опит. За да включите по-нови промени, започнете нова компилация.
BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS.tr: Yeniden deneme, o denemenin ayarlarını kullanır. Daha yeni değişiklikleri eklemek için yeni bir derleme başlatın.

BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.en: Constants apply on the next build.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.es: Las constantes se aplican en la próxima compilación.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.fr: Les constantes s’appliquent lors de la prochaine compilation.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.it: Le costanti si applicano alla prossima build.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.de: Konstanten werden beim nächsten Build übernommen.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.pt: As constantes são aplicadas na próxima compilação.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.nl: Constanten worden toegepast bij de volgende build.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.el: Οι σταθερές εφαρμόζονται στο επόμενο build.
BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS.bg: Константите се прилагат при следващия билд.

BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.en: Used to sign the app on the next build. Passwords and files are never shown again after you save them.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.es: Se usan para firmar la app en la próxima compilación. Las contraseñas y los archivos no se vuelven a mostrar después de guardarlos.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.fr: Utilisés pour signer l’app lors de la prochaine compilation. Les mots de passe et les fichiers ne sont plus jamais affichés après leur enregistrement.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.it: Usati per firmare l’app alla prossima build. Password e file non vengono più mostrati dopo il salvataggio.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.de: Wird beim nächsten Build zum Signieren der App verwendet. Passwörter und Dateien werden nach dem Speichern nie wieder angezeigt.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.pt: Usados para assinar o app na próxima compilação. Senhas e arquivos nunca são exibidos novamente depois que você os salva.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.da: Bruges til at signere appen ved næste build. Adgangskoder og filer vises aldrig igen, når du har gemt dem.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.nl: Wordt gebruikt om de app te ondertekenen bij de volgende build. Wachtwoorden en bestanden worden na het opslaan nooit meer getoond.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.ar: تُستخدم لتوقيع التطبيق في الإصدار التالي. لا تُعرض كلمات المرور والملفات مرة أخرى بعد حفظها.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.el: Χρησιμοποιούνται για την υπογραφή της εφαρμογής στο επόμενο build. Οι κωδικοί πρόσβασης και τα αρχεία δεν εμφανίζονται ξανά μετά την αποθήκευση.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.bg: Използват се за подписване на приложението при следващия билд. Паролите и файловете не се показват повече, след като ги запазите.
BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS.tr: Bir sonraki derlemede uygulamayı imzalamak için kullanılır. Şifreler ve dosyalar kaydedildikten sonra bir daha gösterilmez.

BUILDER_HINT_FILES.en: Files apply on the next build. Each one is checked against its format and size.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.es: Los archivos se aplican en la próxima compilación. Se comprueba el formato y el tamaño de cada uno.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.fr: Les fichiers s’appliquent lors de la prochaine compilation. Le format et la taille de chacun sont vérifiés.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.it: I file si applicano alla prossima build. Di ognuno vengono controllati formato e dimensioni.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.de: Dateien werden beim nächsten Build übernommen. Format und Größe jeder Datei werden geprüft.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.pt: Os arquivos são aplicados na próxima compilação. O formato e o tamanho de cada um são verificados.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.da: Filer anvendes ved næste build. Hver fil kontrolleres for format og størrelse.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.nl: Bestanden worden toegepast bij de volgende build. Van elk bestand worden formaat en grootte gecontroleerd.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.ar: تُطبَّق الملفات في الإصدار التالي. يُتحقَّق من تنسيق كل ملف وحجمه.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.el: Τα αρχεία εφαρμόζονται στο επόμενο build. Κάθε αρχείο ελέγχεται ως προς τη μορφή και το μέγεθός του.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.bg: Файловете се прилагат при следващия билд. Всеки файл се проверява за формат и размер.
BUILDER_HINT_FILES.tr: Dosyalar bir sonraki derlemede uygulanır. Her dosyanın biçimi ve boyutu kontrol edilir.

BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.en: Changes to the app apply on the next build. The name in Ordering changes right away.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.es: Los cambios en la app se aplican en la próxima compilación. El nombre en Ordering cambia al instante.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.fr: Les modifications de l’app s’appliquent lors de la prochaine compilation. Le nom dans Ordering change immédiatement.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.it: Le modifiche all’app si applicano alla prossima build. Il nome in Ordering cambia subito.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.de: Änderungen an der App werden beim nächsten Build übernommen. Der Name in Ordering ändert sich sofort.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.pt: As alterações no app são aplicadas na próxima compilação. O nome no Ordering muda na hora.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.da: Ændringer af appen anvendes ved næste build. Navnet i Ordering ændres med det samme.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.nl: Wijzigingen in de app worden toegepast bij de volgende build. De naam in Ordering verandert meteen.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.ar: تُطبَّق التغييرات على التطبيق في الإصدار التالي. يتغيّر الاسم في Ordering فورًا.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.el: Οι αλλαγές στην εφαρμογή εφαρμόζονται στο επόμενο build. Το όνομα στο Ordering αλλάζει αμέσως.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.bg: Промените в приложението се прилагат при следващия билд. Името в Ordering се променя веднага.
BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL.tr: Uygulamadaki değişiklikler bir sonraki derlemede uygulanır. Ordering’deki ad hemen değişir.

BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.en: Applies right away, without a build. Use the account of the Firebase project this app uses.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.es: Se aplica al instante, sin compilar. Usa la cuenta del proyecto de Firebase que usa esta app.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.fr: S’applique immédiatement, sans build. Utilisez le compte du projet Firebase de cette app.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.it: Si applica subito, senza compilare. Usa l’account del progetto Firebase usato da questa app.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.de: Gilt sofort, ohne Build. Verwende das Konto des Firebase-Projekts, das diese App nutzt.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.pt: Aplica-se na hora, sem compilar. Use a conta do projeto do Firebase que este app usa.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.da: Gælder med det samme uden build. Brug kontoen fra det Firebase-projekt, som appen bruger.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.nl: Geldt meteen, zonder build. Gebruik het account van het Firebase-project dat deze app gebruikt.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.ar: يُطبَّق فورًا دون بناء. استخدم حساب مشروع Firebase الذي يستخدمه هذا التطبيق.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.el: Εφαρμόζεται αμέσως, χωρίς build. Χρησιμοποιήστε τον λογαριασμό του έργου Firebase που χρησιμοποιεί αυτή η εφαρμογή.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.bg: Прилага се веднага, без компилиране. Използвайте акаунта на проекта във Firebase, който приложението използва.
BUILDER_HINT_PUSH.tr: Derleme gerekmeden hemen uygulanır. Bu uygulamanın kullandığı Firebase projesinin hesabını kullanın.

BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.en: Complete these and try again. Issues marked Ordering don’t stop it.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.es: Completa esto y vuelve a intentarlo. Lo marcado como Ordering no lo detiene.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.fr: Complétez ces éléments et réessayez. Les problèmes marqués Ordering ne bloquent pas.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.it: Completa questi elementi e riprova. I problemi contrassegnati con Ordering non lo bloccano.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.de: Vervollständige das und versuche es erneut. Mit Ordering markierte Probleme halten es nicht auf.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.pt: Complete isto e tente novamente. Os problemas marcados como Ordering não impedem.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.da: Udfyld dette, og prøv igen. Problemer markeret med Ordering stopper det ikke.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.nl: Vul dit aan en probeer het opnieuw. Problemen gemarkeerd met Ordering houden het niet tegen.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.ar: أكمل ما يلي وحاول مرة أخرى. المشكلات المعلَّمة بـ Ordering لا تمنعه.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.el: Συμπληρώστε τα παρακάτω και δοκιμάστε ξανά. Τα προβλήματα με την ένδειξη Ordering δεν το σταματούν.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.bg: Попълнете това и опитайте отново. Проблемите, отбелязани с Ordering, не го спират.
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP.tr: Bunları tamamlayıp tekrar deneyin. Ordering olarak işaretlenen sorunlar engel olmaz.

BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_TITLE.fr: _name_ ne peut pas encore être activée
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_TITLE.el: Το _name_ δεν μπορεί να ενεργοποιηθεί ακόμα
BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_TITLE.bg: _name_ все още не може да се активира

BUILDER_INSTALL_GUIDE.fr: Enregistrez des appareils ou utilisez un MDM
BUILDER_INSTALL_GUIDE.it: Registra i dispositivi o usa un MDM

BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.en: Scan with the iPhone’s camera. Only registered devices can install it.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.es: Escanéalo con la cámara del iPhone. Solo los dispositivos registrados pueden instalarla.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.fr: Scannez-le avec l’appareil photo de l’iPhone. Seuls les appareils enregistrés peuvent l’installer.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.it: Scansionalo con la fotocamera dell’iPhone. Solo i dispositivi registrati possono installarla.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.de: Mit der iPhone-Kamera scannen. Nur registrierte Geräte können sie installieren.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.pt: Escaneie com a câmera do iPhone. Só dispositivos registrados podem instalar.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.da: Scan med iPhonens kamera. Kun registrerede enheder kan installere den.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.nl: Scan met de camera van de iPhone. Alleen geregistreerde apparaten kunnen hem installeren.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.ar: امسحه بكاميرا iPhone. يمكن للأجهزة المسجّلة فقط تثبيته.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.el: Σαρώστε με την κάμερα του iPhone. Μόνο οι καταχωρημένες συσκευές μπορούν να την εγκαταστήσουν.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.bg: Сканирайте с камерата на iPhone. Само регистрирани устройства могат да го инсталират.
BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP.tr: iPhone kamerasıyla tarayın. Yalnızca kayıtlı cihazlar yükleyebilir.

BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.en: QR code to install the app
BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.es: Código QR para instalar la app
BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.pt: Código QR para instalar o app
BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.nl: QR-code om de app te installeren
BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.el: Κωδικός QR για εγκατάσταση της εφαρμογής
BUILDER_INSTALL_QR.bg: QR код за инсталиране на приложението

BUILDER_LOAD_ERROR.de: Deine Apps konnten nicht geladen werden

BUILDER_LOAD_ERROR_HELP.da: Tjek din forbindelse, og prøv igen.

BUILDER_LOAD_ERROR_HELP.el: Ελέγξτε τη σύνδεσή σας και δοκιμάστε ξανά.
BUILDER_LOAD_ERROR_HELP.bg: Проверете връзката си и опитайте отново.

BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.en: We couldn’t load the log. Try again.
BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.es: No pudimos cargar el log. Inténtalo de nuevo.
BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.fr: Impossible de charger le journal. Réessayez.
BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.it: Non siamo riusciti a caricare il log. Riprova.

BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.pt: Não foi possível carregar o log. Tente novamente.
BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.da: Vi kunne ikke indlæse loggen. Prøv igen.
BUILDER_LOG_ERROR.nl: We konden de log niet laden. Probeer het opnieuw.

BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.en: There’s no log yet. It appears once the build starts.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.es: Aún no hay log. Aparece cuando empieza la compilación.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.fr: Pas encore de journal. Il apparaît au démarrage du build.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.it: Non c’è ancora un log. Compare quando inizia la compilazione.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.de: Noch kein Log. Es erscheint, sobald der Build startet.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.pt: Ainda não há log. Ele aparece quando a compilação começa.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.da: Der er ingen log endnu. Den vises, når buildet starter.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.nl: Er is nog geen log. Die verschijnt zodra de build start.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.ar: لا يوجد سجل بعد. يظهر بمجرد بدء البناء.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.el: Δεν υπάρχει ακόμα αρχείο καταγραφής. Εμφανίζεται μόλις ξεκινήσει το build.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.bg: Все още няма лог. Появява се, когато компилацията започне.
BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED.tr: Henüz günlük yok. Derleme başladığında görünür.

BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.en: The build service isn’t responding. Try again in a few minutes.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.es: El servicio de compilación no responde. Inténtalo en unos minutos.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.fr: Le service de build ne répond pas. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.it: Il servizio di compilazione non risponde. Riprova tra qualche minuto.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.de: Der Build-Dienst antwortet nicht. Versuche es in ein paar Minuten erneut.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.pt: O serviço de compilação não está respondendo. Tente em alguns minutos.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.da: Byggetjenesten svarer ikke. Prøv igen om et par minutter.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.nl: De buildservice reageert niet. Probeer het over een paar minuten opnieuw.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.ar: خدمة البناء لا تستجيب. حاول بعد بضع دقائق.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.el: Η υπηρεσία build δεν αποκρίνεται. Δοκιμάστε ξανά σε λίγα λεπτά.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.bg: Услугата за компилиране не отговаря. Опитайте след няколко минути.
BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE.tr: Derleme hizmeti yanıt vermiyor. Birkaç dakika sonra tekrar deneyin.

BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.en: After you save it, activate the website again.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.es: Después de guardarlo, vuelve a activar el sitio web.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.fr: Après l’avoir enregistré, activez à nouveau le site web.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.it: Dopo averlo salvato, attiva di nuovo il sito web.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.de: Aktiviere die Website erneut, nachdem du ihn gespeichert hast.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.pt: Depois de salvá-lo, ative o site novamente.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.da: Når du har gemt det, skal du aktivere websitet igen.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.nl: Activeer de website opnieuw nadat je hem hebt opgeslagen.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.ar: بعد حفظه، فعّل الموقع مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.el: Αφού το αποθηκεύσετε, ενεργοποιήστε ξανά τον ιστότοπο.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.bg: След като го запазите, активирайте уебсайта отново.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT.tr: Kaydettikten sonra web sitesini yeniden etkinleştirin.

BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.en: A website needs a name before it goes active. It’s the name you see in Ordering; your customers don’t see it.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.es: Un sitio web necesita un nombre antes de activarse. Es el nombre que ves en Ordering; tus clientes no lo ven.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.fr: Un site web a besoin d’un nom avant d’être activé. C’est le nom que vous voyez dans Ordering ; vos clients ne le voient pas.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.it: Un sito web ha bisogno di un nome prima di essere attivato. È il nome che vedi in Ordering; i tuoi clienti non lo vedono.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.de: Eine Website braucht einen Namen, bevor sie aktiv wird. Es ist der Name, den du in Ordering siehst; deine Kunden sehen ihn nicht.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.pt: Um site precisa de um nome antes de ser ativado. É o nome que você vê no Ordering; seus clientes não o veem.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.da: Et website skal have et navn, før det bliver aktivt. Det er navnet, du ser i Ordering; dine kunder ser det ikke.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.nl: Een website heeft een naam nodig voordat hij actief wordt. Het is de naam die je in Ordering ziet; je klanten zien hem niet.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.ar: يحتاج الموقع إلى اسم قبل تفعيله. إنه الاسم الذي تراه في Ordering؛ ولا يراه عملاؤك.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.el: Ένας ιστότοπος χρειάζεται όνομα πριν ενεργοποιηθεί. Είναι το όνομα που βλέπετε στο Ordering· οι πελάτες σας δεν το βλέπουν.
BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT.bg: Уебсайтът се нуждае от име, преди да бъде активиран. Това е името, което виждате в Ordering; клиентите ви не го виждат.

BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.bg: Push известията не са настроени за този проект. Свържете се с поддръжката на Ordering.
BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE.tr: Bu projede anlık bildirimler ayarlanmamış. Ordering destek ekibiyle iletişime geçin.
