BUILDER_PUSH_LOAD_ERROR.bg: Не успяхме да заредим настройките за push

BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.en: Neither this app nor your project has a Firebase account, so push notifications aren’t sent. Add one to send them.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.es: Ni esta app ni tu proyecto tienen una cuenta de Firebase, así que no se envían notificaciones push. Agrega una para enviarlas.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.fr: Ni cette app ni votre projet n’ont de compte Firebase : les notifications push ne sont donc pas envoyées. Ajoutez-en un pour les envoyer.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.it: Né questa app né il tuo progetto hanno un account Firebase, quindi le notifiche push non vengono inviate. Aggiungine uno per inviarle.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.de: Weder diese App noch dein Projekt hat ein Firebase-Konto, daher werden keine Push-Benachrichtigungen gesendet. Füge eines hinzu, um sie zu senden.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.pt: Nem este app nem seu projeto têm uma conta do Firebase, então as notificações push não são enviadas. Adicione uma para enviá-las.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.da: Hverken denne app eller dit projekt har en Firebase-konto, så der sendes ingen pushnotifikationer. Tilføj en for at sende dem.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.nl: Deze app en je project hebben geen Firebase-account, dus er worden geen pushmeldingen verstuurd. Voeg er een toe om ze te versturen.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.ar: لا يملك هذا التطبيق ولا مشروعك حساب Firebase، لذا لا تُرسل الإشعارات الفورية. أضف حسابًا لإرسالها.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.el: Ούτε αυτή η εφαρμογή ούτε το έργο σας έχουν λογαριασμό Firebase, οπότε δεν στέλνονται ειδοποιήσεις push. Προσθέστε έναν για να σταλούν.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.bg: Нито това приложение, нито проектът ви има акаунт във Firebase, затова push известия не се изпращат. Добавете акаунт, за да се изпращат.
BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP.tr: Ne bu uygulamanın ne de projenizin bir Firebase hesabı var, bu yüzden anlık bildirim gönderilmiyor. Göndermek için bir hesap ekleyin.

BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.en: Push notifications to this app’s devices use its own Firebase account.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.es: Las notificaciones push a los dispositivos de esta app usan su propia cuenta de Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.fr: Les notifications push vers les appareils de cette app utilisent son propre compte Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.it: Le notifiche push ai dispositivi di questa app usano il suo account Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.de: Push-Benachrichtigungen an die Geräte dieser App nutzen ihr eigenes Firebase-Konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.pt: As notificações push para os dispositivos deste app usam a conta própria do Firebase dele.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.da: Pushnotifikationer til denne apps enheder bruger dens egen Firebase-konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.nl: Pushmeldingen naar de apparaten van deze app gebruiken het eigen Firebase-account van de app.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.ar: تستخدم الإشعارات الفورية لأجهزة هذا التطبيق حساب Firebase الخاص به.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.el: Οι ειδοποιήσεις push προς τις συσκευές αυτής της εφαρμογής χρησιμοποιούν τον δικό της λογαριασμό Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.bg: Push известията до устройствата на това приложение използват собствения му акаунт във Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP.tr: Bu uygulamanın cihazlarına giden anlık bildirimler kendi Firebase hesabını kullanır.

BUILDER_PUSH_PASTE_INSTEAD.fr: Coller le contenu à la place
BUILDER_PUSH_PASTE_INSTEAD.nl: In plaats daarvan de inhoud plakken

BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.en: Push notifications to this app’s devices use your project’s Firebase account.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.es: Las notificaciones push a los dispositivos de esta app usan la cuenta de Firebase de tu proyecto.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.fr: Les notifications push vers les appareils de cette app utilisent le compte Firebase de votre projet.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.it: Le notifiche push ai dispositivi di questa app usano l’account Firebase del tuo progetto.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.de: Push-Benachrichtigungen an die Geräte dieser App nutzen das Firebase-Konto deines Projekts.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.pt: As notificações push para os dispositivos deste app usam a conta do Firebase do seu projeto.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.da: Pushnotifikationer til denne apps enheder bruger dit projekts Firebase-konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.nl: Pushmeldingen naar de apparaten van deze app gebruiken het Firebase-account van je project.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.ar: تستخدم الإشعارات الفورية لأجهزة هذا التطبيق حساب Firebase الخاص بمشروعك.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.el: Οι ειδοποιήσεις push προς τις συσκευές αυτής της εφαρμογής χρησιμοποιούν τον λογαριασμό Firebase του έργου σας.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.bg: Push известията до устройствата на това приложение използват акаунта във Firebase на проекта ви.
BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP.tr: Bu uygulamanın cihazlarına giden anlık bildirimler projenizin Firebase hesabını kullanır.

BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.en: We couldn’t remove the account. Try again.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.es: No pudimos quitar la cuenta. Inténtalo de nuevo.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.fr: Impossible de retirer le compte. Réessayez.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.it: Non siamo riusciti a rimuovere l’account. Riprova.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.de: Das Konto konnte nicht entfernt werden. Versuche es noch einmal.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.pt: Não foi possível remover a conta. Tente novamente.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.da: Vi kunne ikke fjerne kontoen. Prøv igen.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.nl: We konden het account niet verwijderen. Probeer het opnieuw.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.ar: تعذّرت إزالة الحساب. حاول مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αφαίρεση του λογαριασμού. Δοκιμάστε ξανά.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR.bg: Не успяхме да премахнем акаунта. Опитайте отново.

BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.en: Push notifications to _name_ go back to your project’s account right away, if it has one. If the app uses another Firebase project, they stop arriving.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.es: Las notificaciones push a _name_ vuelven a la cuenta de tu proyecto al instante, si tiene una. Si la app usa otro proyecto de Firebase, dejan de llegar.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.fr: Les notifications push vers _name_ repassent immédiatement par le compte de votre projet, s’il en a un. Si l’app utilise un autre projet Firebase, elles n’arrivent plus.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.it: Le notifiche push a _name_ tornano subito all’account del tuo progetto, se ne ha uno. Se l’app usa un altro progetto Firebase, smettono di arrivare.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.de: Push-Benachrichtigungen an _name_ nutzen sofort wieder das Konto deines Projekts, falls es eines hat. Nutzt die App ein anderes Firebase-Projekt, kommen sie nicht mehr an.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.pt: As notificações push para _name_ voltam na hora para a conta do seu projeto, se houver uma. Se o app usa outro projeto do Firebase, elas deixam de chegar.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.da: Pushnotifikationer til _name_ går straks tilbage til dit projekts konto, hvis det har en. Hvis appen bruger et andet Firebase-projekt, holder de op med at komme frem.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.nl: Pushmeldingen naar _name_ gaan meteen terug naar het account van je project, als dat er een heeft. Gebruikt de app een ander Firebase-project, dan komen ze niet meer aan.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.ar: تعود الإشعارات الفورية إلى _name_ فورًا لاستخدام حساب مشروعك، إن وُجد. إذا كان التطبيق يستخدم مشروع Firebase آخر، فستتوقف عن الوصول.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.el: Οι ειδοποιήσεις push προς _name_ επιστρέφουν αμέσως στον λογαριασμό του έργου σας, αν υπάρχει. Αν η εφαρμογή χρησιμοποιεί άλλο έργο Firebase, θα σταματήσουν να φτάνουν.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.bg: Push известията до _name_ веднага се връщат към акаунта на проекта ви, ако има такъв. Ако приложението използва друг проект във Firebase, те спират да пристигат.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP.tr: _name_ uygulamasına giden anlık bildirimler, varsa hemen projenizin hesabına döner. Uygulama başka bir Firebase projesi kullanıyorsa bildirimler gelmez.

BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_TITLE.pt: Remover a conta própria do Firebase?
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_TITLE.ar: هل تريد إزالة حساب Firebase الخاص به؟
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_TITLE.el: Αφαίρεση του δικού του λογαριασμού Firebase;
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_TITLE.bg: Да се премахне ли собственият акаунт във Firebase?

BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.en: Removed. Push notifications to _name_ use your project’s account.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.es: Quitada. Las notificaciones push a _name_ usan la cuenta de tu proyecto.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.fr: Retiré. Les notifications push vers _name_ utilisent le compte de votre projet.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.it: Rimosso. Le notifiche push a _name_ usano l’account del tuo progetto.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.de: Entfernt. Push-Benachrichtigungen an _name_ nutzen das Konto deines Projekts.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.pt: Removida. As notificações push para _name_ usam a conta do seu projeto.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.da: Fjernet. Pushnotifikationer til _name_ bruger dit projekts konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.nl: Verwijderd. Pushmeldingen naar _name_ gebruiken het account van je project.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.ar: تمت الإزالة. تستخدم الإشعارات الفورية إلى _name_ حساب مشروعك.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.el: Αφαιρέθηκε. Οι ειδοποιήσεις push προς _name_ χρησιμοποιούν τον λογαριασμό του έργου σας.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.bg: Премахнат. Push известията до _name_ използват акаунта на проекта ви.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED.tr: Kaldırıldı. _name_ için anlık bildirimler projenizin hesabını kullanır.

BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.en: Removed. Push notifications to _name_ aren’t sent until you add an account.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.es: Quitada. No se envían notificaciones push a _name_ hasta que agregues una cuenta.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.fr: Retiré. Aucune notification push n’est envoyée à _name_ tant que vous n’ajoutez pas de compte.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.it: Rimosso. Le notifiche push a _name_ non vengono inviate finché non aggiungi un account.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.de: Entfernt. Push-Benachrichtigungen an _name_ werden erst gesendet, wenn du ein Konto hinzufügst.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.pt: Removida. As notificações push para _name_ não são enviadas até você adicionar uma conta.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.da: Fjernet. Der sendes ingen pushnotifikationer til _name_, før du tilføjer en konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.nl: Verwijderd. Er worden geen pushmeldingen naar _name_ verstuurd totdat je een account toevoegt.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.ar: تمت الإزالة. لن تُرسل الإشعارات الفورية إلى _name_ حتى تضيف حسابًا.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.el: Αφαιρέθηκε. Δεν στέλνονται ειδοποιήσεις push προς _name_ μέχρι να προσθέσετε λογαριασμό.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.bg: Премахнат. Push известия до _name_ не се изпращат, докато не добавите акаунт.
BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE.tr: Kaldırıldı. Bir hesap ekleyene kadar _name_ için anlık bildirim gönderilmez.

BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.en: We couldn’t save the account. Try again.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.es: No pudimos guardar la cuenta. Inténtalo de nuevo.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.it: Non siamo riusciti a salvare l’account. Riprova.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.de: Das Konto konnte nicht gespeichert werden. Versuche es noch einmal.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.pt: Não foi possível salvar a conta. Tente novamente.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.da: Vi kunne ikke gemme kontoen. Prøv igen.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.nl: We konden het account niet opslaan. Probeer het opnieuw.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.ar: تعذّر حفظ الحساب. حاول مرة أخرى.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.el: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η αποθήκευση του λογαριασμού. Δοκιμάστε ξανά.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR.bg: Не успяхме да запазим акаунта. Опитайте отново.

BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.en: Saved. Push notifications to _name_ use its own Firebase account.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.es: Guardada. Las notificaciones push a _name_ usan su propia cuenta de Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.fr: Enregistré. Les notifications push vers _name_ utilisent son propre compte Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.it: Salvato. Le notifiche push a _name_ usano il suo account Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.de: Gespeichert. Push-Benachrichtigungen an _name_ nutzen ihr eigenes Firebase-Konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.pt: Salva. As notificações push para _name_ usam a conta própria do Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.da: Gemt. Pushnotifikationer til _name_ bruger dens egen Firebase-konto.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.nl: Opgeslagen. Pushmeldingen naar _name_ gebruiken het eigen Firebase-account.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.ar: تم الحفظ. تستخدم الإشعارات الفورية إلى _name_ حساب Firebase الخاص به.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.el: Αποθηκεύτηκε. Οι ειδοποιήσεις push προς _name_ χρησιμοποιούν τον δικό του λογαριασμό Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.bg: Запазено. Push известията до _name_ използват собствения му акаунт във Firebase.
BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED.tr: Kaydedildi. _name_ için anlık bildirimler kendi Firebase hesabını kullanır.

BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.en: Open the Firebase console and choose the app’s project.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.es: Abre la consola de Firebase y elige el proyecto de la app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.fr: Ouvrez la console Firebase et choisissez le projet de l’app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.it: Apri la console Firebase e scegli il progetto dell’app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.de: Öffne die Firebase-Konsole und wähle das Projekt der App.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.pt: Abra o console do Firebase e escolha o projeto do app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.da: Åbn Firebase-konsollen, og vælg appens projekt.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.nl: Open de Firebase-console en kies het project van de app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.ar: افتح وحدة تحكم Firebase واختر مشروع التطبيق.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.el: Ανοίξτε την κονσόλα Firebase και επιλέξτε το έργο της εφαρμογής.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.bg: Отворете конзолата на Firebase и изберете проекта на приложението.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE.tr: Firebase konsolunu açın ve uygulamanın projesini seçin.

BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.en: Click Generate new private key and confirm. Firebase downloads a .json file.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.es: Haz clic en Generar nueva clave privada y confirma. Firebase descarga un archivo .json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.fr: Cliquez sur Générer une nouvelle clé privée et confirmez. Firebase télécharge un fichier .json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.it: Fai clic su Genera nuova chiave privata e conferma. Firebase scarica un file .json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.de: Klicke auf Neuen privaten Schlüssel generieren und bestätige. Firebase lädt eine .json-Datei herunter.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.pt: Clique em Gerar nova chave privada e confirme. O Firebase baixa um arquivo .json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.da: Klik på Generér ny privat nøgle, og bekræft. Firebase downloader en .json-fil.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.nl: Klik op Nieuwe privésleutel genereren en bevestig. Firebase downloadt een .json-bestand.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.ar: انقر على إنشاء مفتاح خاص جديد وأكّد. ينزّل Firebase ملف ‎.json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.el: Κάντε κλικ στο Δημιουργία νέου ιδιωτικού κλειδιού και επιβεβαιώστε. Το Firebase κατεβάζει ένα αρχείο .json.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.bg: Щракнете върху Генериране на нов частен ключ и потвърдете. Firebase изтегля .json файл.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE.tr: Yeni özel anahtar oluştur’a tıklayıp onaylayın. Firebase bir .json dosyası indirir.

BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.en: Go to Project settings → Service accounts.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.es: Ve a Configuración del proyecto → Cuentas de servicio.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.fr: Allez dans Paramètres du projet → Comptes de service.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.it: Vai in Impostazioni progetto → Account di servizio.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.pt: Acesse Configurações do projeto → Contas de serviço.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.ar: انتقل إلى إعدادات المشروع ← حسابات الخدمة.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.el: Μεταβείτε στις Ρυθμίσεις έργου → Λογαριασμοί υπηρεσίας.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.bg: Отидете в Настройки на проекта → Акаунти за услуги.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS.tr: Proje ayarları → Hizmet hesapları bölümüne gidin.

BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.en: Upload that file here. Keep it private: it lets anyone send pushes to your app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.es: Sube ese archivo aquí. Mantenlo privado: permite a cualquiera enviar push a tu app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.fr: Importez ce fichier ici. Gardez-le privé : il permet à n’importe qui d’envoyer des push à votre app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.it: Carica qui quel file. Tienilo privato: permette a chiunque di inviare push alla tua app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.de: Lade die Datei hier hoch. Halte sie geheim: Damit kann jeder Pushes an deine App senden.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.pt: Envie esse arquivo aqui. Mantenha-o privado: ele permite que qualquer pessoa envie push para seu app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.da: Upload filen her. Hold den privat: Den lader alle sende push til din app.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.nl: Upload dat bestand hier. Houd het privé: hiermee kan iedereen pushmeldingen naar je app sturen.
BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD.ar: ارفع ذلك الملف هنا. احتفظ به سرًا: فهو يتيح لأي شخص إرسال إشعارات إلى تطبيقك.

BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE.it: Il tuo sito web è online

BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.en: It’s at _domain_, a temporary address, even while it’s a draft. You can add your own domain, theme and stores in an upcoming update.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.es: Está en _domain_, una dirección temporal, aunque sea un borrador. Podrás agregar tu propio dominio, tema y tiendas en una próxima actualización.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.fr: Il est sur _domain_, une adresse temporaire, même en brouillon. Vous pourrez ajouter votre propre domaine, thème et magasins dans une prochaine mise à jour.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.it: È su _domain_, un indirizzo temporaneo, anche se è una bozza. Potrai aggiungere il tuo dominio, il tema e i negozi in un prossimo aggiornamento.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.de: Sie ist unter _domain_ erreichbar, einer vorübergehenden Adresse, auch als Entwurf. Eigene Domain, Theme und Geschäfte kannst du in einem kommenden Update hinzufügen.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.pt: Ele está em _domain_, um endereço temporário, mesmo sendo rascunho. Você poderá adicionar seu próprio domínio, tema e lojas em uma próxima atualização.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.da: Det ligger på _domain_, en midlertidig adresse, selv som kladde. Du kan tilføje dit eget domæne, tema og butikker i en kommende opdatering.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.nl: Hij staat op _domain_, een tijdelijk adres, ook als concept. Je eigen domein, thema en winkels kun je in een volgende update toevoegen.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.ar: إنه على _domain_، وهو عنوان مؤقت، حتى وهو مسودة. ستتمكن من إضافة نطاقك ومظهرك ومتاجرك في تحديث قادم.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.el: Βρίσκεται στο _domain_, μια προσωρινή διεύθυνση, ακόμα κι ως πρόχειρο. Θα μπορείτε να προσθέσετε δικό σας τομέα, θέμα και καταστήματα σε επόμενη ενημέρωση.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.bg: Намира се на _domain_, временен адрес, дори като чернова. Ще можете да добавите собствен домейн, тема и магазини в предстояща актуализация.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_HELP.tr: Taslak olsa bile geçici bir adres olan _domain_ üzerinde. Kendi alan adınızı, temanızı ve mağazalarınızı yakında gelecek bir güncellemeyle ekleyebilirsiniz.

BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.en: It’s at _domain_ and at its temporary address, _temporary_. Theme and stores come in an upcoming update.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.es: Está en _domain_ y en su dirección temporal, _temporary_. El tema y las tiendas llegan en una próxima actualización.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.fr: Il est à _domain_ et à son adresse temporaire, _temporary_. Le thème et les magasins arrivent dans une prochaine mise à jour.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.it: È su _domain_ e al suo indirizzo temporaneo, _temporary_. Tema e negozi arriveranno in un prossimo aggiornamento.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.de: Sie ist unter _domain_ und unter ihrer temporären Adresse _temporary_ erreichbar. Theme und Geschäfte kommen in einem der nächsten Updates.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.pt: Ele está em _domain_ e no endereço temporário, _temporary_. Tema e lojas chegam em uma próxima atualização.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.da: Det er på _domain_ og på sin midlertidige adresse, _temporary_. Tema og butikker kommer i en kommende opdatering.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.nl: Hij staat op _domain_ en op het tijdelijke adres, _temporary_. Thema en winkels komen in een volgende update.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.ar: إنه على _domain_ وعلى عنوانه المؤقت _temporary_. يأتي المظهر والمتاجر في تحديث قادم.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.el: Βρίσκεται στο _domain_ και στην προσωρινή του διεύθυνση, _temporary_. Το θέμα και τα καταστήματα έρχονται σε επόμενη ενημέρωση.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.bg: Намира се на _domain_ и на временния си адрес, _temporary_. Темата и магазините идват в следваща актуализация.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_OWN.tr: _domain_ adresinde ve geçici adresi _temporary_ üzerinde yayında. Tema ve mağazalar yakında gelecek bir güncellemeyle eklenecek.

BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.en: It’s at _domain_, a temporary address, even while it’s a draft. You can add your own domain below. Theme and stores come in an upcoming update.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.es: Está en _domain_, una dirección temporal, aunque sea un borrador. Puedes agregar tu propio dominio abajo. El tema y las tiendas llegan en una próxima actualización.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.fr: Il est à _domain_, une adresse temporaire, même à l’état de brouillon. Vous pouvez ajouter votre propre domaine ci-dessous. Le thème et les magasins arrivent dans une prochaine mise à jour.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.it: È su _domain_, un indirizzo temporaneo, anche se è una bozza. Puoi aggiungere il tuo dominio qui sotto. Tema e negozi arriveranno in un prossimo aggiornamento.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.de: Sie ist unter _domain_ erreichbar, einer temporären Adresse, auch als Entwurf. Unten kannst du deine eigene Domain hinzufügen. Theme und Geschäfte kommen in einem der nächsten Updates.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.pt: Ele está em _domain_, um endereço temporário, mesmo sendo um rascunho. Você pode adicionar seu próprio domínio abaixo. Tema e lojas chegam em uma próxima atualização.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.da: Det er på _domain_, en midlertidig adresse, også som kladde. Du kan tilføje dit eget domæne nedenfor. Tema og butikker kommer i en kommende opdatering.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.nl: Hij staat op _domain_, een tijdelijk adres, ook als concept. Hieronder kun je je eigen domein toevoegen. Thema en winkels komen in een volgende update.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.ar: إنه على _domain_، وهو عنوان مؤقت، حتى وهو مسودة. يمكنك إضافة نطاقك الخاص أدناه. يأتي المظهر والمتاجر في تحديث قادم.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.el: Βρίσκεται στο _domain_, μια προσωρινή διεύθυνση, ακόμη και ως πρόχειρο. Μπορείτε να προσθέσετε δικό σας τομέα παρακάτω. Το θέμα και τα καταστήματα έρχονται σε επόμενη ενημέρωση.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.bg: Намира се на _domain_, временен адрес, дори като чернова. Можете да добавите собствен домейн по-долу. Темата и магазините идват в следваща актуализация.
BUILDER_WEB_ONLINE_TEMPORARY.tr: Taslak olsa bile geçici bir adres olan _domain_ üzerinde yayında. Aşağıdan kendi alan adınızı ekleyebilirsiniz. Tema ve mağazalar yakında gelecek bir güncellemeyle eklenecek.

BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.en: Websites go online right away at a temporary address, even as a draft. You can add your own domain, theme and stores later.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.es: Las webs quedan en línea al instante en una dirección temporal, aunque sean un borrador. Puedes agregar tu propio dominio, tema y tiendas más adelante.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.fr: Les sites sont en ligne immédiatement sur une adresse temporaire, même en brouillon. Vous pourrez ajouter votre propre domaine, thème et magasins plus tard.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.it: I siti web vanno subito online su un indirizzo temporaneo, anche come bozza. Potrai aggiungere il tuo dominio, il tema e i negozi in seguito.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.de: Websites sind sofort unter einer vorübergehenden Adresse online, auch als Entwurf. Eigene Domain, Theme und Geschäfte kannst du später hinzufügen.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.pt: Os sites ficam no ar na hora em um endereço temporário, mesmo como rascunho. Você pode adicionar seu próprio domínio, tema e lojas depois.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.da: Websites går online med det samme på en midlertidig adresse, selv som kladde. Du kan tilføje dit eget domæne, tema og butikker senere.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.nl: Websites gaan meteen online op een tijdelijk adres, ook als concept. Je eigen domein, thema en winkels kun je later toevoegen.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.ar: تصبح المواقع متاحة فورًا على عنوان مؤقت، حتى وهي مسودة. يمكنك إضافة نطاقك ومظهرك ومتاجرك لاحقًا.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.el: Οι ιστότοποι βγαίνουν αμέσως online σε προσωρινή διεύθυνση, ακόμα κι ως πρόχειρο. Μπορείτε να προσθέσετε δικό σας τομέα, θέμα και καταστήματα αργότερα.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.bg: Сайтовете стават онлайн веднага на временен адрес, дори като чернова. Можете да добавите собствен домейн, тема и магазини по-късно.
BUILDER_WEBSITE_ONLINE_NOTE.tr: Web siteleri taslak olsa bile hemen geçici bir adreste yayına girer. Kendi alan adınızı, temanızı ve mağazalarınızı daha sonra ekleyebilirsiniz.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.en: To post something on Facebook, you first need to choose the audience to which your advertising is directed.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.es: Para publicar algo en Facebook, primero debes elegir la audiencia a la que se dirige tu publicidad.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.fr: Pour publier quelque chose sur Facebook, vous devez d’abord choisir le public auquel votre publicité s’adresse.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.it: Per pubblicare qualcosa su Facebook devi prima scegliere il pubblico a cui è diretta la tua pubblicità.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.de: Um etwas auf Facebook zu posten, müssen Sie zunächst die Zielgruppe auswählen, an die sich Ihre Werbung richtet.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.pt: Para postar algo no Facebook, primeiro você precisa escolher o público ao qual sua publicidade será direcionada.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.da: For at poste noget på Facebook skal du først vælge den målgruppe, som din annoncering er rettet mod.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.nl: Om iets op Facebook te plaatsen, moet u eerst de doelgroep kiezen waarop uw reclame is gericht.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.ar: لنشر شيء ما على فيسبوك، يتعين عليك أولاً اختيار الجمهور الذي يتم توجيه إعلانك إليه.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.el: Για να δημοσιεύσετε κάτι στο Facebook, πρέπει πρώτα να επιλέξετε το κοινό στο οποίο απευθύνεται η διαφήμισή σας.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.bg: За да публикувате нещо във Facebook, първо трябва да изберете аудиторията, към която е насочена вашата реклама.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP1_DESC.tr: Facebook'ta bir şey paylaşmak için öncelikle reklamınızın yönlendirileceği hedef kitleyi seçmeniz gerekir.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.en: Then, add what you will publish on your page, and that's it!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.es: Luego, agrega lo que publicarás en tu página, ¡y listo!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.fr: Ensuite, ajoutez ce que vous allez publier sur votre page, et c'est tout !
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.it: Quindi, aggiungi ciò che pubblicherai sulla tua pagina e il gioco è fatto!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.de: Fügen Sie dann hinzu, was Sie auf Ihrer Seite veröffentlichen möchten, und fertig!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.pt: Depois, adicione o que você vai publicar na sua página e pronto!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.da: Tilføj derefter, hvad du vil offentliggøre på din side, og det er det!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.nl: Voeg vervolgens toe wat u op uw pagina gaat publiceren, en dat is alles!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.ar: ثم أضف ما ستنشره على صفحتك، وهذا كل شيء!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.el: Στη συνέχεια, προσθέστε τι θα δημοσιεύσετε στη σελίδα σας, και αυτό είναι!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.bg: След това добавете какво ще публикувате на страницата си и това е!
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_POST_STEP2_DESC.tr: Daha sonra sayfanızda yayınlayacağınız şeyleri ekleyin, işte bu kadar!

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.en: Copy this link below. It’s your unique Ordering link for facebook.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.it: Copia questo collegamento qui sotto. È il tuo link di ordinazione univoco per Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.de: Kopieren Sie diesen Link unten. Es ist Ihr einzigartiger Bestelllink für Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.pt: Copie este link abaixo. É o seu link de pedido exclusivo para o Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.da: Kopier dette link nedenfor. Det er dit unikke bestillingslink til facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.nl: Kopieer deze link hieronder. Het is uw unieke bestellink voor Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.ar: انسخ هذا الرابط أدناه. إنه رابط الطلب الفريد الخاص بك على الفيسبوك.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.el: Αντιγράψτε αυτόν τον σύνδεσμο παρακάτω. Είναι ο μοναδικός σας σύνδεσμος παραγγελίας για το facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.bg: Копирайте тази връзка по-долу. Това е вашата уникална връзка за поръчка във facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP1_DESC.tr: Bu bağlantıyı aşağıya kopyalayın. Bu, Facebook için benzersiz Sipariş bağlantınızdır.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.en: In your business profile, click on the 3 points button on the right side of the screen and look for the option: Edit Action Button.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.es: En tu perfil comercial, haz clic en el botón de 3 puntos en el lado derecho de la pantalla y busca la opción: Editar Botón de Acción.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.fr: Dans votre profil d'entreprise, cliquez sur le bouton 3 points sur le côté droit de l'écran et recherchez l'option : Modifier le bouton d'action.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.it: Nel tuo profilo aziendale, fai clic sul pulsante con i 3 punti sul lato destro dello schermo e cerca l'opzione: Modifica pulsante di azione.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.de: Klicken Sie in Ihrem Unternehmensprofil auf die Schaltfläche „3 Punkte“ auf der rechten Seite des Bildschirms und suchen Sie nach der Option „Aktionsschaltfläche bearbeiten“.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.pt: No perfil do seu negócio, clique no botão de 3 pontos do lado direito da tela e procure a opção: Editar botão de ação.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.da: I din virksomhedsprofil skal du klikke på knappen 3 punkter i højre side af skærmen og se efter muligheden: Rediger handlingsknap.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.nl: Klik in uw bedrijfsprofiel op de 3-puntenknop aan de rechterkant van het scherm en zoek naar de optie: Actieknop bewerken.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.ar: في ملف تعريف عملك، انقر فوق زر النقاط الثلاث الموجود على الجانب الأيمن من الشاشة وابحث عن الخيار: تعديل زر الإجراء.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.el: Στο προφίλ της επιχείρησής σας, κάντε κλικ στο κουμπί 3 σημείων στη δεξιά πλευρά της οθόνης και αναζητήστε την επιλογή: Κουμπί επεξεργασίας ενέργειας.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.bg: Във вашия бизнес профил щракнете върху бутона с 3 точки от дясната страна на екрана и потърсете опцията: Бутон за редактиране на действие.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP2_DESC.tr: İşletme profilinizde ekranın sağ tarafındaki 3 noktalı düğmeye tıklayın ve şu seçeneği arayın: Eylem Düğmesini Düzenle.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.en: Please choose the option that best suits you from the following list; this time, we will select: Start Order.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.es: Elija la opción que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades de la siguiente lista; esta vez seleccionaremos: Iniciar Orden.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.fr: Veuillez choisir l'option qui vous convient le mieux dans la liste suivante ; cette fois, nous sélectionnerons : Démarrer la commande.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.it: Scegli l'opzione più adatta a te dal seguente elenco; questa volta selezioneremo: Avvia ordine.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.de: Bitte wählen Sie aus der folgenden Liste die Option aus, die am besten zu Ihnen passt. Dieses Mal wählen wir: Bestellung starten.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.pt: Escolha a opção que melhor se adapta a você na lista a seguir; desta vez, selecionaremos: Iniciar pedido.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.da: Vælg venligst den mulighed, der passer bedst til dig, fra følgende liste; denne gang vælger vi: Start ordre.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.nl: Kies uit de volgende lijst de optie die het beste bij u past; deze keer selecteren we: Startvolgorde.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.ar: يرجى اختيار الخيار الذي يناسبك من القائمة التالية؛ هذه المرة، سوف نختار: بدء الطلب.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.el: Επιλέξτε την επιλογή που σας ταιριάζει καλύτερα από την παρακάτω λίστα. αυτή τη φορά, θα επιλέξουμε: Έναρξη παραγγελίας.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.bg: Моля, изберете опцията, която ви подхожда най-добре от следния списък; този път ще изберем: Начална поръчка.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP3_DESC.tr: Lütfen aşağıdaki listeden size en uygun seçeneği seçin; bu sefer şunu seçeceğiz: Siparişi Başlat.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.en: It will open a popup where you will put the link to your business where your client can place the order and click Save.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.es: Se abrirá una ventana emergente donde colocará el enlace a su empresa donde su cliente puede realizar el pedido y hacer clic en Guardar.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.fr: Cela ouvrira une fenêtre contextuelle dans laquelle vous mettrez le lien vers votre entreprise où votre client pourra passer la commande et cliquer sur Enregistrer.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.it: Si aprirà un popup in cui inserirai il collegamento alla tua attività in cui il tuo cliente potrà effettuare l'ordine e fare clic su Salva.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.de: Es öffnet sich ein Popup, in dem Sie den Link zu Ihrem Unternehmen einfügen, wo Ihr Kunde die Bestellung aufgeben und auf Speichern klicken kann.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.pt: Irá abrir um popup onde você colocará o link do seu negócio onde seu cliente poderá fazer o pedido e clicar em Salvar.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.da: Det åbner en popup, hvor du vil placere linket til din virksomhed, hvor din kunde kan afgive ordren og klikke på Gem.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.nl: Er wordt een pop-up geopend waarin u de link naar uw bedrijf plaatst waar uw klant de bestelling kan plaatsen en op Opslaan klikt.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.ar: سيتم فتح نافذة منبثقة حيث ستضع الرابط لعملك حيث يمكن لعميلك تقديم الطلب والنقر فوق حفظ.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.el: Θα ανοίξει ένα αναδυόμενο παράθυρο όπου θα τοποθετήσετε τον σύνδεσμο προς την επιχείρησή σας όπου ο πελάτης σας μπορεί να υποβάλει την παραγγελία και κάντε κλικ στην Αποθήκευση.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.bg: Ще се отвори изскачащ прозорец, където ще поставите връзката към вашия бизнес, където вашият клиент може да направи поръчката, и щракнете върху Запазване.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP4_DESC.tr: Müşterinizin sipariş verebileceği işletmenizin bağlantısını koyacağınız bir açılır pencere açılacaktır ve Kaydet'e tıklayabilirsiniz.

BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.en: And voila, you will see the button you just added to your Facebook page.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.es: Y listo, verás el botón que acabas de agregar a tu página de Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.fr: Et voilà, vous verrez le bouton que vous venez d'ajouter à votre page Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.it: E voilà, vedrai il pulsante che hai appena aggiunto alla tua pagina Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.de: Und voilà, Sie sehen den Button, den Sie gerade zu Ihrer Facebook-Seite hinzugefügt haben.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.pt: E pronto, você verá o botão que acabou de adicionar à sua página do Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.da: Og voila, du vil se den knap, du lige har tilføjet til din Facebook-side.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.nl: En voila, je ziet de knop die je zojuist aan je Facebook-pagina hebt toegevoegd.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.ar: وفويلا، سترى الزر الذي أضفته للتو إلى صفحتك على الفيسبوك.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.el: Και voila, θα δείτε το κουμπί που μόλις προσθέσατε στη σελίδα σας στο Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.bg: И готово, ще видите бутона, който току-що добавихте към страницата си във Facebook.
BUSINESS_FACEBOOK_PROFILE_STEP5_DESC.tr: Ve işte, Facebook sayfanıza yeni eklediğiniz düğmeyi göreceksiniz.

BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.en: On Google My Business, access your Locations page.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.es: En Google My Business, acceda a su página Ubicaciones.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.fr: Sur Google My Business, accédez à votre page Emplacements.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.it: Su Google My Business, accedi alla pagina Sedi.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.de: Rufen Sie in Google My Business die Seite „Standorte“ auf.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.pt: No Google Meu Negócio, acesse sua página Locais.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.da: Gå til din Locations-side på Google My Business.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.nl: Ga op Google Mijn Bedrijf naar de pagina Locaties.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.ar: في نشاطي التجاري على Google، قم بالوصول إلى صفحة المواقع الخاصة بك.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.el: Στο Google My Business, μεταβείτε στη σελίδα Τοποθεσίες.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.bg: В Google My Business отворете страницата си с местоположения.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP1_DESC.tr: Google Benim İşletmem'de Konumlar sayfanıza erişin.

BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.en: Then click on info section on the sidebar inside your location.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.es: Luego haga clic en la sección de información en la barra lateral dentro de su ubicación.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.fr: Cliquez ensuite sur la section d'informations dans la barre latérale à l'intérieur de votre emplacement.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.it: Quindi fai clic sulla sezione informazioni sulla barra laterale all'interno della tua posizione.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.de: Klicken Sie dann in der Seitenleiste an Ihrem Standort auf den Infobereich.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.pt: Em seguida, clique na seção de informações na barra lateral da sua localização.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.da: Klik derefter på infosektionen på sidebjælken inde i din placering.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.nl: Klik vervolgens op het infogedeelte in de zijbalk op uw locatie.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.ar: ثم انقر فوق قسم المعلومات في الشريط الجانبي داخل موقعك.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.el: Στη συνέχεια, κάντε κλικ στην ενότητα πληροφοριών στην πλαϊνή γραμμή μέσα στην τοποθεσία σας.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.bg: След това щракнете върху секцията с информация в страничната лента във вашето местоположение.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP2_DESC.tr: Daha sonra bulunduğunuz yerin içindeki kenar çubuğundaki bilgi bölümüne tıklayın.

BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.en: Scroll down and find Order ahead links and Menu link fields. Paste the link below.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.es: Desplácese hacia abajo y busque los enlaces Ordenar con anticipación y los campos de enlace del Menú. Pegue el enlace a continuación.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.fr: Faites défiler vers le bas et recherchez les liens Commande à l’avance et les champs de lien de menu. Collez le lien ci-dessous.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.it: Scorri verso il basso e trova i collegamenti Ordina avanti e i campi dei collegamenti al menu. Incolla il link qui sotto.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.de: Scrollen Sie nach unten und finden Sie die Links „Vorbestellung“ und die Felder „Menü-Link“. Fügen Sie den Link unten ein.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.pt: Role para baixo e encontre os links Pedido antecipado e os campos de link do menu. Cole o link abaixo.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.da: Rul ned og find Bestil frem-links og menu-linkfelter. Indsæt linket nedenfor.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.nl: Scroll naar beneden en vind de links Bestel vooruit en Menulinkvelden. Plak de onderstaande link.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.ar: قم بالتمرير لأسفل وابحث عن روابط الطلب المسبق وحقول رابط القائمة. الصق الرابط أدناه.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.el: Κάντε κύλιση προς τα κάτω και βρείτε τους συνδέσμους Παραγγελία εκ των προτέρων και τα πεδία συνδέσμου μενού. Επικολλήστε τον παρακάτω σύνδεσμο.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.bg: Превъртете надолу и намерете връзки за поръчка и полета за връзки към менюто. Поставете връзката по-долу.
BUSINESS_GOOGLE_STEP3_DESC.tr: Aşağı kaydırın ve İleri sipariş bağlantıları ve Menü bağlantısı alanlarını bulun. Bağlantıyı aşağıya yapıştırın.

BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.en: This business is in the following driver groups
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.es: Esta empresa se encuentra en los siguientes grupos de conductores.
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.fr: Cette entreprise fait partie des groupes de pilotes suivants
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.it: Questa attività è nei seguenti gruppi di conducenti
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.de: Dieses Unternehmen gehört zu den folgenden Fahrergruppen
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.pt: Esta empresa está nos seguintes grupos de motoristas
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.da: Denne virksomhed er i følgende chaufførgrupper
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.nl: Dit bedrijf bevindt zich in de volgende chauffeursgroepen
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.ar: هذا العمل موجود في مجموعات التشغيل التالية
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.el: Αυτή η επιχείρηση ανήκει στις ακόλουθες ομάδες οδηγών
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.bg: Този бизнес е в следните групи водачи
BUSINESS_IN_FOLLOWING_DRIVER_GROUPS.tr: Bu işletme aşağıdaki sürücü gruplarında yer alıyor

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.en: This setting is if your Instagram account has 10K followers or you are already an Instagram partner.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.es: Esta configuración es válida si tu cuenta de Instagram tiene 10.000 seguidores o si ya eres socio de Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.fr: Ce paramètre est valable si votre compte Instagram compte 10 000 abonnés ou si vous êtes déjà un partenaire Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.it: Questa impostazione è se il tuo account Instagram ha 10.000 follower o se sei già un partner Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.de: Diese Einstellung gilt, wenn Ihr Instagram-Konto 10.000 Follower hat oder Sie bereits Instagram-Partner sind.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.pt: Essa configuração é válida se sua conta do Instagram tiver 10 mil seguidores ou se você já for um parceiro do Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.da: Denne indstilling er, hvis din Instagram-konto har 10.000 følgere, eller du allerede er en Instagram-partner.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.nl: Deze instelling is van toepassing als je Instagram-account 10.000 volgers heeft of als je al een Instagram-partner bent.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.ar: يتم هذا الإعداد إذا كان حساب Instagram الخاص بك يضم 10 آلاف متابع أو إذا كنت شريكًا في Instagram بالفعل.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.el: Αυτή η ρύθμιση είναι εάν ο λογαριασμός σας στο Instagram έχει 10 χιλιάδες ακόλουθους ή εάν είστε ήδη συνεργάτης του Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.bg: Тази настройка е, ако акаунтът ви в Instagram има 10 хиляди последователи или вече сте партньор на Instagram.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_DESC.tr: Bu ayar, Instagram hesabınızın 10K takipçisi varsa veya zaten bir Instagram ortağıysanız geçerlidir.

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.en: Click on Action buttons and then select the button you need.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.es: Haga clic en Botones de acción y luego seleccione el botón que necesita.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.fr: Cliquez sur Boutons d'action puis sélectionnez le bouton dont vous avez besoin.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.it: Fai clic su Pulsanti di azione e quindi seleziona il pulsante che ti interessa.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.de: Klicken Sie auf Aktionsschaltflächen und wählen Sie dann die gewünschte Schaltfläche aus.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.pt: Clique em Botões de ação e selecione o botão necessário.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.da: Klik på Handlingsknapper og vælg derefter den knap, du har brug for.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.nl: Klik op Actieknoppen en selecteer vervolgens de gewenste knop.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.ar: انقر فوق أزرار الإجراء ثم حدد الزر الذي تحتاجه.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.el: Κάντε κλικ στα κουμπιά Action και, στη συνέχεια, επιλέξτε το κουμπί που χρειάζεστε.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.bg: Кликнете върху бутони за действие и след това изберете бутона, от който се нуждаете.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP3_DESC.tr: Eylem düğmeleri üzerine tıklayın ve ardından ihtiyacınız olan düğmeyi seçin.

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.en: Now, select Your business, and paste the following link. Then, tap on Done
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.es: Ahora, seleccione Su negocio y pegue el siguiente enlace. Luego, toque Done
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.fr: Maintenant, sélectionnez Votre entreprise et collez le lien suivant. Ensuite, appuyez sur Done
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.it: Ora seleziona La tua attività e incolla il seguente collegamento. Quindi, tocca Fine
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.de: Wählen Sie nun Ihr Unternehmen aus und fügen Sie den folgenden Link ein. Tippen Sie dann auf Fertig
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.pt: Agora, selecione Seu negócio e cole o link a seguir. Em seguida, toque em Done
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.da: Vælg nu Din virksomhed, og indsæt følgende link. Tryk derefter på Done
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.nl: Selecteer nu Uw bedrijf en plak de volgende link. Tik vervolgens op Gereed
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_ADVANCED_STEP4_DESC.ar: الآن، حدد عملك، ثم قم بلصق الرابط التالي. ثم اضغط على Done

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP3_DESC.pt: Na tela Editar perfil, clique na opção Links.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP3_DESC.da: På skærmbilledet Rediger profil skal du klikke på indstillingen Links.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP3_DESC.nl: Klik in het scherm Profiel bewerken op de optie Links.

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP3_DESC.tr: Profili Düzenle ekranında Bağlantılar seçeneğine tıklayın.

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.en: Add your business link, or if you already have a link, you can edit it; click on that option.

BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.it: Aggiungi il link della tua attività o, se ne hai già uno, puoi modificarlo; fare clic su tale opzione.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.de: Fügen Sie Ihren Geschäftslink hinzu. Wenn Sie bereits einen Link haben, können Sie ihn bearbeiten. Klicken Sie auf diese Option.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.pt: Adicione o link da sua empresa ou, se já tiver um link, você pode editá-lo; clique nessa opção.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.da: Tilføj dit virksomhedslink, eller hvis du allerede har et link, kan du redigere det; klik på den mulighed.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.nl: Voeg uw bedrijfslink toe, of als u al een link heeft, kunt u deze bewerken; klik op die optie.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.ar: أضف رابط عملك، أو إذا كان لديك رابط بالفعل، يمكنك تعديله؛ انقر على هذا الخيار.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.el: Προσθέστε τον σύνδεσμο της επιχείρησής σας ή εάν έχετε ήδη έναν σύνδεσμο, μπορείτε να τον επεξεργαστείτε. κάντε κλικ σε αυτήν την επιλογή.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.bg: Добавете вашата бизнес връзка или ако вече имате връзка, можете да я редактирате; щракнете върху тази опция.
BUSINESS_INSTAGRAM_GENERAL_STEP4_DESC.tr: İşletme bağlantınızı ekleyin veya zaten bir bağlantınız varsa onu düzenleyebilirsiniz; o seçeneğe tıklayın.

BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.en: Efficiently handle business payments with tailored invoices using Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.es: Gestione de manera eficiente los pagos comerciales con facturas personalizadas utilizando Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.fr: Gérez efficacement les paiements professionnels avec des factures personnalisées à l'aide de Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.it: Gestisci in modo efficiente i pagamenti aziendali con fatture personalizzate utilizzando Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.de: Erledigen Sie Geschäftszahlungen effizient mit maßgeschneiderten Rechnungen mit Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.pt: Lide com pagamentos comerciais de maneira eficiente com faturas personalizadas usando Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.da: Håndter forretningsbetalinger effektivt med skræddersyede fakturaer ved hjælp af Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.nl: Zakelijke betalingen efficiënt afhandelen met facturen op maat met Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.ar: تعامل مع مدفوعات الأعمال بكفاءة من خلال فواتير مخصصة باستخدام Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.el: Διαχειριστείτε αποτελεσματικά τις επιχειρηματικές πληρωμές με προσαρμοσμένα τιμολόγια χρησιμοποιώντας το Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.bg: Ефективно обработвайте бизнес плащания с персонализирани фактури с помощта на Orderingplus.
BUSINESS_INVOICE_DESCRIPTION.tr: Orderingplus'ı kullanarak özel faturalarla iş ödemelerini verimli bir şekilde yönetin.

BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.en: Add a banner inside your business listing to let everyone know about your latest promotions inside your businesses listed.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.es: Agregue un banner dentro de la lista de su empresa para que todos sepan acerca de sus últimas promociones dentro de las empresas enumeradas.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.fr: Ajoutez une bannière à l'intérieur de votre fiche d'entreprise pour informer tout le monde de vos dernières promotions au sein de vos entreprises répertoriées.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.it: Aggiungi un banner all'interno della scheda della tua attività per far conoscere a tutti le tue ultime promozioni all'interno delle attività elencate.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.de: Fügen Sie Ihrem Brancheneintrag ein Banner hinzu, um alle über Ihre neuesten Werbeaktionen in den aufgeführten Unternehmen zu informieren.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.pt: Adicione um banner na listagem de sua empresa para que todos saibam sobre suas últimas promoções nas empresas listadas.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.da: Tilføj et banner i din virksomhedsfortegnelse for at fortælle alle om dine seneste kampagner i dine angivne virksomheder.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.nl: Voeg een banner toe aan uw bedrijfsvermelding om iedereen op de hoogte te stellen van uw nieuwste promoties binnen uw vermelde bedrijven.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.ar: أضف لافتة داخل قائمة أعمالك لإعلام الجميع بأحدث العروض الترويجية داخل قائمة أعمالك المدرجة.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.el: Προσθέστε ένα banner στην καταχώριση της επιχείρησής σας, για να ενημερώσετε όλους για τις πιο πρόσφατες προσφορές σας στις επιχειρήσεις σας που αναφέρονται στη λίστα.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.bg: Добавете банер в малката си бизнес обява, за да уведомите всички за най-новите ви промоции във вашите изброени фирми.
BUSINESS_LISTING_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.tr: Listelenen işletmenizdeki en son promosyonlarınızı herkesin bilmesini sağlamak için işletme listenize bir banner ekleyin.

BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.en: Add a banner inside the business page, and inform news and promotions specifically of the stores customers are ordering from.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.es: Agregue un banner dentro de la página comercial e informe noticias y promociones específicamente de las tiendas en las que los clientes realizan pedidos.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.fr: Ajoutez une bannière à l'intérieur de la page commerciale et informez les actualités et les promotions spécifiquement des magasins dans lesquels les clients commandent.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.it: Aggiungi un banner all'interno della pagina aziendale e informa specificamente su novità e promozioni dei negozi da cui i clienti effettuano gli ordini.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.de: Fügen Sie ein Banner auf der Unternehmensseite hinzu und informieren Sie über Neuigkeiten und Sonderangebote speziell für die Geschäfte, in denen Kunden bestellen.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.pt: Adicione um banner dentro da página comercial e informe novidades e promoções especificamente das lojas nas quais os clientes estão fazendo pedidos.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.da: Tilføj et banner på virksomhedssiden, og informer nyheder og kampagner specifikt om de butikker, kunderne bestiller fra.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.nl: Voeg een banner toe op de bedrijfspagina en informeer nieuws en promoties specifiek over de winkels waar klanten bestellen.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.ar: قم بإضافة لافتة داخل صفحة الأعمال، وأبلغ بالأخبار والعروض الترويجية الخاصة بالمتاجر التي يطلب العملاء منها.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.el: Προσθέστε ένα banner εντός της σελίδας της επιχείρησης και ενημερώστε τα νέα και τις προσφορές ειδικά για τα καταστήματα από τα οποία παραγγέλνουν οι πελάτες.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.bg: Добавете банер в бизнес страницата и информирайте за новини и промоции специално за магазините, от които клиентите поръчват.
BUSINESS_PAGE_BANNER_DESCRIPTION.tr: İşletme sayfasına bir banner ekleyin ve özellikle müşterilerin sipariş verdiği mağazalara ilişkin haber ve promosyonları bilgilendirin.

BUSINESS_SYNC_STARTED.fr: Synchronisation de l’entreprise lancée. Cela peut prendre quelques minutes.
BUSINESS_SYNC_STARTED.it: Sincronizzazione dell’attività avviata. Potrebbe richiedere alcuni minuti.

BUSINESS_SYNC_STARTED.pt: Sincronização do negócio iniciada. Pode levar alguns minutos.
